columns.name: MARKET_IDENTIFIER_CD
columns.comment:
The Market Identifier Code (MIC) is a unique identification code used to identify securities trading exchanges, regulated and non-regulated trading markets. The MIC is a four alpha character code and is defined in ISO 10383 by International Organization for Standardization (ISO). The MIC is updated by ISO regularly and can be downloaded from https://www.iso10383.org
 
ETF share classes may have several listings while having only one ISIN, i.e. there is an 1:n relation between share class and exchange places.
 
Notice: Please use "MIC" and not "Operating MIC".

columns.name: COMPOSITE_FIGI
columns.comment: Twelve character, alphanumeric identifier. The first 2 characters are upper-case consonants (including "Y"), the third character is the upper-case "G", characters 4 -11 are any upper-case consonant (including "Y") or integer between 0 and 9, and the last character is a check-digit. The Composite level of assignment is provided in cases where there are multiple trading venues for the instrument within a single country or market. The Composite Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) enables users to link multiple FIGIs at the trading venue-level within the same country or market in order to obtain an aggregated view for that instrument within that country or market.  Note: Where an MTF trades multiple listings, this field will indicate the MTF as composite and the true associated market level is indicated in MTF Assc Mkt Comp Financial Instrument Global ID (ID241, MTF_ASSC_MKT_COMP_ID_BB_GLOBAL).

columns.name: CPI_REFERENCE
columns.comment: The reference CPI (Consumer Price Index) value for the underlying index of inflation-linked bonds. The reference CPI is divided by the base CPI to come up with the index ratio that is used on the inflation-adjusted calculations for a given settlement date.         For inflation-linked bonds that use the Canadian 3-month lookback model, the reference CPI changes with the current settlement date (or each day the bond trades). Reference CPI interpolates the change in CPI value two and three months from the month of the current settlement date.        For Australian and New Zealand capital index bonds, this represents the inflation adjusted value of the security in percentage form.

columns.comment: ABI sectors are defined by the Association of British Insurers (ABI). They are a way of grouping funds with similar characteristics so they’re easier to compare.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_EXPENSES
columns.comment: An allowance for variable fund expenses not included in the Investment Management Charge (IMC). This charge includes the OCF and operation expenses produced annually

columns.name: ADVANCED_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Is this share class suitable to be marketed to an end investor, who can be classified as an 'experienced investor'?
An experienced investor typically has at least one of the following characteristics:
-- good knowledge of relevant financial products and transactions
-- financial industry experience or is accompanied by professional investment advice
Therefore, an informed investor can make an informed investment decision based only on the regulated and authorised offering documentation, together with knowledge and understanding of the specific factors/risks highlighted within them.

columns.name: APPROVED_FOR_DB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved for use by Defined Benefit Pension Schemes (DB).  This is typically "Yes", unless the fund has specific Defined Contribution (DC) features and/or the fund is net of charges or is only available on a daily basis (midday in particular).

columns.name: APPROVED_FOR_DC_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved for use by Defined Contribution Pension Schemes (DC).  The fund would need to have been assessed for any features which would make the fund less appropriate to be applied to DC members. Typically this would not be a "Yes" if the fund is only made available on a weekly basis.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_OF_VALUE_REQUIRED_UNDER_COLL_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates whether  Assessment Of Value is required Under FCA COLL (Collective Investment Schemes Sourcebook) rules. The FCA require authorised fund managers (AFMs) to assess the value for money of each fund.

columns.name: ASSET_CLASS
columns.comment: A grouping of securities, as per the LGIM taxonomy, that exhibit similar characteristics and behave similarly in the marketplace.

columns.name: ASSET_CLASS_SUB_CATEGORY_UBS_VAL
columns.comment: A sub-segment of the Fixed Income Asset Class to provide more granular detail. The Asset Class Sub-Category is a group of securities that exhibit similar characteristics with each other, and also with the broader Asset Class it is part of.

columns.name: AUM_BASED_ON
columns.comment: The Fund(s) from which the AUM (Assets Under Management) should be determined, likely to be the Parent Fund

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_EUR_OLAB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved to be accessed by Non UK Pension Schemes (e.g. Ireland), known as "OLAB" (Overseas Life Assurance Business) which subscribe to the funds in EUR.  Certain funds will be restricted so that OLAB funds cannot access them due to difference in tax treatment on the underlying assets.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_GBP_OLAB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved to be accessed by Non UK Pension Schemes (e.g. Channel Islands, Isle of Man), known as "OLAB" (Overseas Life Assurance Business) which subscribe to the funds in GBP.  Certain funds will be restricted so that OLAB funds cannot access them due to difference in tax treatment on the underlying assets.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_UK_NON_OLAB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved to be accessed by UK Pension Schemes (excluding Channel Islands, Isle of Man).  Generally a "Yes" except specific funds which may be restricted for tax purposes (as there is usually a preferential version available). Certain funds are restricted to UK Pension Schemes which are marked as "PMC Only" for tax purposes.

columns.name: BASIC_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Is this share class suitable to be marketed to an end investor, who has only basic knowledge about financial product, but access to imperative legal documentation and basic information provided by the point of sale?
An investor with basic knowledge is defined as an investor, who has
-- no financial industry experience or
-- is investing for the first time in this kind of financial product.

columns.name: BESPOKE_OR_POOLED_PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comment: Internal identifier for PMC client type (Bespoke - Single /Pooled - Multi investor)

columns.name: BIC_OF_TRANSFER_AGENT
columns.comment: BIC (bank identifier code) for the transfer agent entity of the fund. ISO 9362 defines a standard format of Bank Identifier Codes (also known as SWIFT-BIC, BIC, SWIFT ID or SWIFT code) approved by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

columns.name: BOARD_GENERAL_PARTNER
columns.comment: The entity or individuals responsible for managing the fund, typically the General Partner (GP) in a limited partnership structure.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_100M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets under [$]100M, in basis points.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_100M_250M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets between [$]100M and [$]250M, in basis points.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_250M_500M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets between [$]250M and [$]500M, in basis points.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_500M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets over [$]500M, in basis points.

columns.name: BUSINESS_CAPABILITY
columns.comment: Investment capabilities the firm offers

columns.name: CAN_OVERRIDE_WEEKLY_TO_MONTHLY_IND
columns.comment: A marker for Huguenot to change the wording relating from the default of "weekly" to "monthly" for the funds which are only available on a monthly basis

columns.name: CBI_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.comment: Central bank of Ireland approval date of supplement

columns.name: CBI_CD
columns.comment: Identification code of the approved share class as issued by the regulatory body i.e. CBI

columns.name: CCI_ADVERSE_MARKET_REDEMPTION
columns.comment: A brief explanation of what outcome the investor may expect where the CCI matures, is redeemed, sold, or encashed under severely adverse market conditions

columns.name: CCI_APPROPRIATE_MAIN_PERFORMANCE_DRIVERS
columns.comment: Appropriate performance information summary in narrative form covering the main drivers of investment performance for the CCI

columns.name: CCI_ESG_OBJECTIVES_INFORMATION
columns.comment: Description of any environmental or social objectives of the consumer composite investment

columns.name: CCI_INVESTMENT_DESC
columns.comment: Medium form narrative text version of the investment policy/fund description, which, when combined with the investment objective field (for regulated funds only), is included in the CCI. This is drafted specifically to meet the requirements of this regulatory document.

columns.name: CCI_REQUIRED_IND
columns.comment: CCI required indicator (Flag for Consumer Composite Investment)

columns.name: CCI_RETURN_CONDITIONS_HIGHER_EXPLANATION
columns.comment: A brief explanation of the kind of conditions whereby the CCI is likely to generate higher returns, or lead to investment  gains

columns.name: CCI_RETURN_CONDITIONS_LOWER_EXPLANATION
columns.comment: A brief explanation of the kinds of conditions whereby the consumer composite investment is likely to generate lower returns, or lead to investment loss

columns.name: CCI_UNDERLYING_INVESTMENT_ASSETS
columns.comment: Describes any underlying investment assets or reference values and an explanation of how they relate to the value of the consumer composite investment;

columns.name: CITI_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: CITI generated identifier at Product level.

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_CAN_BEAR_LIMITED_CAPITAL_LOSS_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who is seeking capital preservation or who can bear only limited capital losses that are specified in product's documentation.

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_CAN_BEAR_LOSS_BEYOND_CAPITAL_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who can bear losses even higher than the total amount of his invested capital?

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_CANNOT_BEAR_CAPITAL_LOSS_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who cannot bear any capital losses?

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_DO_NOT_NEED_CAPITAL_GUARANTEE_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who can bear a loss of the total amount of his invested capital?

columns.name: CLOSE_DATE
columns.comment: Date in which client/fund closes

columns.name: COMMITMENT_LEVERAGE_RATIO
columns.comment: The Commitment Method for calculating leverage involves summing the absolute values of an Alternative Investment Fund's (AIF) positions, including the reinvestment of borrowings, and then offsetting certain hedging and netting arrangements to arrive at the total exposure. This calculated exposure is then divided by the AIF's net asset value (NAV) to determine its leverage ratio.

columns.name: COMPREHENSION_CLASSIFICATION
columns.comment:
MIFID securities classification. According to Art. 25 (4)(a) of the MiFID II Directive 2014/65/EU from 15/05/14 or according to PRIIPs RTS Article 8(3)(b) of PRIIPs regulation (EU) No 1286/2014 :
1) Non-complex products are:
     - Shares admitted to trading on a regulated market 
     - Bonds or other forms of securitised debt admitted to trading on a regulated market 
     - Money-market instruments
     - Shares or units in UCITS
     - Structured deposits
2) Complex products are:
    - Shares in non-UCITS collective investment undertakings and shares that embed a derivative
    - Bonds that embed a derivative or incorporate a structure which makes it difficult for the client to understand the risk involved
    - Money-market instruments that embed a derivative or incorporate a structure which makes it difficult for the client to understand the risk    involved
     - Structured UCITS as referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 36(1) of Regulation (EU) No 583/2010;
     - Structured deposits that incorporate a structure which makes it difficult for the client to understand the risk of return or the cost of exiting the product before term."

columns.name: CONSIDERS_CLIENT_SUSTAINABILITY_PREFERENCES_VAL
columns.comment: Is the fund compatible with investor preference for investments with an environmental, social and governance (ESG) focus?

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_IND
columns.comment: Shows which products meet the definition of 'Consolidated' for L&G Group Financial Reporting. Once L&G's ownership of an L&G product reaches 30%, it becomes potentially in scope for IFRS reporting, dependant on final decision from Group.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_IND_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: The date on which a change to the consolidated indicator has been applied

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_BENCHMARK_APPLICABLE
columns.comment: Indicates if a benchmark is 'in' or 'out' of scope of the benchmark regulation.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_BENCHMARK_NAME
columns.comment: Where a fund falls in scope of the Benchmark Regulation, a Contingency Benchmark will be required to be identified and stored for reference.

columns.name: COSTS_INCLUDE_DISTRIBUTION_FEE_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of conditional regulatory text for PRIIPs KIDs supplied in Annex VII. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"These figures include the maximum distribution fee that the person selling you the product may charge ([] % of amount invested/[] EUR). This person will inform you of the actual distribution fee."

columns.name: COSTS_SHARED_WITH_SELLER_VAL
CREDIT_RISK_IND
CREDIT_RISK_MEASURE_VAL
CUSIP
columns.comment: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures' and refers to a 9-digit alphanumeric code assigned to all security issues approved for trading in the United States and Canada.

columns.name: DC_FUND_TYPE
columns.comment: This is an indicator used to determine whether a DC fund invests into one underlying PMC (Single) or multiple underlying PMCs (Blended).

columns.name: DEALING_CUT_OFF_TIME
columns.comment: Dealing cut off time for a Product

columns.name: DEALING_FREQ
columns.comment: Frequency at which fund is traded

columns.name: DEFERRAL_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.comment: If a Fund is able to defer redemptions this attribute will outline the number of months it can be deferred.

columns.name: DEFERRALS_ALLOWED_IND
columns.comment: Some Funds reserve the right to defer redemption requests, e.g. redemptions can be dererred for a period of time. This attribute will outline whether this is possible.

columns.name: DESC_OF_FUND_FULL_NAME
columns.comment: Full Fund Name of the Product as recorded in Fund Literature

columns.name: DILUTION_METHOD_VAL
columns.comment: The dilution method is the mechanism used to protect existing investors from bearing the costs of buying or selling the underlying investments as a result of large inflows into or outflows from a fund. This could be a "Dilution Levy" charged to the investor or "Dilution Adjustment" where the price is swung to adjust for the associated cost of leaving the fund

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_FREQ
columns.comment: The frequency at which Funds distribute dividends.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_PLANNER_TARGETED_VAL
columns.comment: Confirms the fund aligns with a specific risk profile (risk level 1–10) in the Dynamic Planner system.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_COUNTERPARTY_VAL
ELIGIBLE_FOR_ADVISED_RETAIL_DISTRIBUTION_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients by a distributor who advices the end investor? - As this is also dependent from investors ability to bear losses and time horizon, this field can only give an indication to the distributer about how the manufacturer sees it.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_EXECUTION_ONLY_DISTRIBUTION_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients through an execution only channel, e.g. internet platforms, if the end investor is provided the necessary legal documentation? - As this is also dependent from investors knowledge and experience, this field can only give an indication to the distribution channel about how the manufacturer sees it.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_EXECUTION_ONLY_WITH_APPROPRIATENESS_TEST_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients through an execution only channel, e.g. internet platforms, if the end investor is provided the necessary legal documentation and also checks, whether the client has sufficient knowledge, i.e. by providing online tests or by checking client's existing investments? - As this is also dependent from investors knowledge and experience, this field can only give an indication to the distribution channel about how the manufacturer sees it.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients who have given a discretionary mandate to a professional portfolio manager? - As the portfolio manager has the obligation to balance out the portfolio with his client's needs, the usual answer to this field should be "yes".

columns.name: EMBEDDED_DERIVATIVES_IND
columns.comment: If the prospectus allows the usage of derivatives for Efficient Portfolio Management, it will not be classified as a derivative product, i.e. it has no embedded derivatives. 'Yes' means that the fund might be classified as a derivative product and therefore might be classified as riskier.

columns.name: EMT_EPT_TYPE_OF_IDENTIFICATION_CODE_VAL
columns.comment:
Codification chosen to identify the financial instrument. 

One of the options in the following closed list to be used:
1 - ISO 6166 for ISIN code
2 - CUSIP (The Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures number assigned by the CUSIP Service Bureau for U.S. and Canadian companies)
3 - SEDOL (Stock Exchange Daily Official List for the London Stock Exchange)
4 – WKN (Wertpapier Kenn-Nummer, the alphanumeric German identification number)
5 - Bloomberg Ticker (Bloomberg letters code that identify a company's securities)
6 - BBGID (The Bloomberg Global ID)
7 - Reuters RIC (Reuters instrument code)
8 – FIGI (Financial Instrument Global Identifier)
9 - Other code by members of the Association of National Numbering Agencies
10 - LEI
99 - Code attributed by the undertaking

columns.name: EMT_FINANCIAL_INSTRUMENT_PRODUCT_TYPE_VAL
columns.comment:
The legal structure of the instrument for the purposes of the EMT.
The following list describes each meaning of the available alphanum values:

S = Structured Securities
SF = Structured Funds
U = UCITS
N = Non UCITS
UM = UCITS Money Market Funds
NM = Non-UCITS Money Market Funds
ETC = Exchange Traded Commodities
B = Bonds

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is: 
EMT: 00060_Financial_Instrument_Legal_Structure. This is a Mandatory EMT field.//

columns.name: EMT_VALUE_FOR_MONEY_REPORTING_VAL
ENTRY_CHARGE
columns.comment: For PMC Funds this is the entry charge levied by PMC to purchase the fund, for PMC wrapped funds it does not take into account any entry charge levied by the underlying fund.

columns.name: ESG_PRODUCT_IND
columns.comment: Confirms if the product is an ESG product.

columns.name: ESMA_NAMING_MINIMUM_COMMITMENT_TO_ENVIRONMENTAL_TRANSITION_VAL
columns.comment: The minimum percentage of investments planned for this product to meet the intention that investments are on a clear and measurable path to environmental transition

columns.name: ESMA_NAMING_MINIMUM_COMMITMENT_TO_SOCIAL_TRANSITION_VAL
columns.comment: The minimum percentage of investments planned for this product to meet the intention that investments are on a clear and measurable path to social transition

columns.name: EU_DIRECTIVE_RELEVANT_IND
columns.comment: Choose 'yes', if there is any distribution activity within the EU or if the fund has appointed an AIFM according to the AIFM directive 2011/61/EU.

columns.name: EVENT_CUTTOFF_TIME_ZONE
columns.comment:
Relevant time zone for "OFST410100 Cut-off Time For Subscription" or "OFST430100 Cut-off Time For Redemption" in local standard time format._x000D_
_x000D_
Helpful links can be found at:_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_time_zones_by_country_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time_x000D_
- https://www.timeanddate.com/time/zones_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daylight_saving_time_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tz_database_x000D_
_x000D_
Commonly used standard time formats are:_x000D_
- EST    Eastern Time Zone (USA); UTC-05:00_x000D_
- CST   Central Time Zone (USA); UTC-06:00_x000D_
- PST    Pacific Time Zone (USA); UTC-07:00_x000D_
- CET   Central European Time; UTC+01:00_x000D_
- HKT   Hong Kong Time; UTC+08:00_x000D_
- SST    Singapore Standard Time; UTC+08:00_x000D_
_x000D_
Please note, that mentioning the abbreviation of a standard time zone is an approximation as there are many countries that know daylight saving time. In this case openfunds would assume only mentioning one abbreviation, e.g. CET for Central European Time, despite between March and October it should be CEST for Central European Summer Time._x000D_
_x000D_
Additionally, openfunds recommends not to use this field for automatic implementation, as there are quite some identical abbreviations for different time zones, e.g. ADT stands for Arabia Daylight Time (UTC+3:00) or Atlantic Daylight Time (UTC-3:00)._x000D_
_x000D_
For automatic information exchange please refer to "OFST410092 Time Zone For Cut-off Using TZ Database"

columns.name: EX_DIVIDEND_DATE
columns.comment: The day after the distribution period end where all distributable income is stripped from the respective Fund price.

columns.name: EXIT_CHARGE
columns.comment: For PMC Funds this is the exit charge levied by PMC to exit the fund, for PMC wrapped funds it does not take into account any exit charge levied by the underlying fund.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CAP_VALUE
columns.comment: Cap on operational expenses (bps) of the product.

columns.name: EXPERT_INVESTOR_GER_VAL
columns.comment: Does the investor have expert knowledge of and / or experience with highly specialised financial products (e.g. CFDs and products with contingent liabilities)? This is a regulatory requirement in Germany.

columns.name: EXPOST_COST_CALCULATION_BASIS_FOR_ITALY_VAL
columns.comment:
Whether ex-post costs are calculated on a rolling basis (last 12 months to a given date) or over a fixed period  (calendar year).

R - Rolling basis (last 12 months)
F - Fixed basis (calendar year)

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is:
EMT: 00120_Ex_Post_Cost_Calculation_Basis_Italy. This is a Conditional EMT field.//

columns.name: EXPOSURE_TYPE
columns.comment: For Equity Index Funds, the exposure offered by the product.(LGIMA Usage)

columns.name: FACILITIES_AGENT_VAL
columns.comment: An entity appointed to ensure facilities (as prescribed under EU Directive 2019/1160 and EU Regulation 2019/1156) are made available in an EU Member State where the fund/product is marketed

columns.name: FACTSHEET_ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.comment: Additional free text field to include information that may need to be disclosed in factsheets (or other literature) e.g. details of prior fund names, benchmarks etc

columns.name: FACTSHEET_CHARACTERISTICS
columns.comment: Describes the key elements of the fund i.e. strategy, investment style, asset class exposure etc. This is presented as the 'Fund Characteristics' on the Fact Sheet

columns.name: FACTSHEET_PRICE_SERIES_TYPE
columns.comment: Hierarchal approach where the Price series used will be the Weekly Close (if available and accessible by policyholders), otherwise Daily Close (if available and accessible by policyholders), otherwise Daily Midday (if available and accessible by policyholders). Default if not available at any price series should be Weekly Close.

columns.name: FACTSHEET_REPORTING_BASIS
columns.comment: Indicates whether the factsheets (not member comms) use a gross of net of fees performance return.  Should be gross by default

columns.name: FACTSHEET_RISKS
columns.comment: PMC Description - A field required to capture the fund specific risks as detailed on the PMC factsheets

columns.name: FCA_AUTHORISATION_DATE
columns.comment: Date fund approved in the UK by the FCA

columns.name: FEE_TIER_1_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the first portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 1 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 1 MV, this is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_2_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 2 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 2 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing Tier 1 MV.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_3_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 3 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 3 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_4_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 4 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 4 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_5_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 5 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 5 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_6_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 6 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 6 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_7_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 7 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 7 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TYPE
columns.comment: How the fees are structured for the product.(LGIMA Usage)

columns.name: FEEDER_IND
columns.comment: Does the fund follow a master-feeder structure?

columns.name: FIRST_CLOSE_END_DATE
columns.comment: Closed ended funds will have a specified period in which they can raise capital. This attribute will be the end date of the first close.

columns.name: FIRST_CLOSE_START_DATE
columns.comment: Closed ended funds will have a specified period in which they can raise capital. This attribute will be the start date of the first close.

columns.name: FLAT_AMC
columns.comment: The ad valorem fee is based on the average value of the policy’s holdings - on a dealing price basis in the daily dealt funds.

columns.name: FPF_CD
columns.comment: A unique identifier from the FPF administrative system for Workplace funds.

columns.name: FUND_BATCH_TYPE
columns.comment: Used for grouping individual funds of a similar nature e.g. single stock gilt funds (batched funds) or funds which are similar, but have different 'maturities' e.g. target date funds (cohorts)

columns.name: FUND_CALENDAR
columns.comment: The Fund Calendar assigned to this product based on fund type and geographic considerations.

columns.name: FUND_GROUP_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates the asset types within the Fund's investment profile

columns.name: FUND_LENDING_CD
columns.comment: Only required for LLC pooled funds, indicates if Fund is lending or non lending

columns.name: FUND_MANAGEMENT_CHARGE
columns.comment: This charge is the sum of the Investment Management Charge and Additional Expenses for Workplace (Bundled) Products.

columns.name: FUND_NAME_FOR_FACTSHEET
columns.comment: This is the Fund Name which is displayed on factsheets for DC (Workplace and Non-Workplace) funds.

columns.name: FUND_OF_FUNDS_IND
columns.comment: The Fund invests into other pooled funds vs. exclusively investing in direct securities.

columns.name: FUND_PERFORMANCE_DATE
columns.comment: The date that performance history is available from if no override

columns.name: FUND_STATUS_DESC
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund is or will be captured in the Description of Funds

columns.name: GATING_ALLOWED_IND
columns.comment: Some Funds reserve the right to gate, e.g. not allow further redemptions. This attribute will outline whether this is possible.

columns.name: GEARING_RATIO
columns.comment: The metric that shows how much debt a company uses to finance its assets compared to the equity provided by shareholders

columns.name: GENERAL_CLASSIFICATION_VAL
columns.comment: Internal classification to indicate if the PMC Fund is Standard (available to multiple investors), Client Specific (available to a single investor or closely related investors), Externally Managed (invests in a collective investment scheme not managed within the L&G Group), Transition (a short term restructuring account) or other (typically operational or obsolete)

columns.name: GERMAN_INVESTMENT_TAX_IND
columns.comment:
Is the fund an investment fund according to §1 of the German Investment Tax Act (Investmentsteuergesetz, InvStG)? If the fund is not subject to the German Investment Tax Act, the answer is no. _x000D_
_x000D_
The relevant paragraphs can be found at (only in German):_x000D_
http://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/invstg_2018/BJNR173010016.html#BJNR173010016BJNG000100000

columns.name: GERMAN_TAX_CATEGORY
columns.comment: German tax category as regulated by the German Investmentsteuergesetz (InvStG) §5ff. This field is used to indicate whether the German authorities regard investors as owners of units in the fund (intransparent) or as owners of a share of the underlying fund assets ('transparent')”

columns.name: GROSS_LEVERAGE_RATIO
columns.comment: Under AIFMD (Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive), gross leverage measures a fund's total exposure by summing the absolute values of all positions, excluding highly liquid cash and cash equivalents but including reinvested cash borrowings and the equivalent exposure from derivatives. This figure is then compared to the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV) to determine the gross leverage ratio, indicating the total exposure regardless of any hedging or netting strategies.

columns.name: GROSS_OR_NET_RETURNS
columns.comment: Whether the return type is gross or net. This would typically be where fees are applicable.

columns.name: HAS_CAPITA_PRESERVATION_VAL
columns.comment:
Identifies if a capital preservation method is used (yes) or not (no).

This field should be used if the loss of a fund over a certain time period (e.g. monthly or annually) is limited due to a (partial) guarantee (e.g. 75% or 90%). It might be different from the field OFEP040810 EPT Capital Guarantee Level which specifies the level of guarantee at the RHP. 

//This field was declared mandatory for the German market (PIA model) by the European Working Group in their PRIIPs Data Dictionary Template (EPT). The correspondent PRIIP field within the PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT) is:
EPT: 06040_Existing_Capital_Preservation//

columns.name: HAS_CAPITAL_GUARANTEE_AGAINST_CREDIT_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element I in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"If we are not able to pay you what is owed, you could lose your entire investment."

columns.name: HAS_CAPITAL_GUARANTEE_IND
columns.comment:
Has the fund a general capital guarantee? If the answer is "no", "OFEP040840 EPT Capital Guarantee Characteristics", "OFEP040810 EPT Capital Guarantee Level", "OFEP040820 EPT Capital Guarantee Limitations" and "OFEP040830 EPT Capital Guarantee Early Exit Conditions Date" should be kept empty.

//This field was introduced by the European Working Group with their EPT PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT).
EPT: 04080_Capital_Guarantee//

Also used as a boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element F in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"[You are entitled to receive back at least [insert %] of your capital. Any amount over this, and any additional return, depends on future market performance and is uncertain.]"

columns.name: HAS_CAPITAL_PROTECTION_AGAINST_MARKET_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element H in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"[This product does not include any protection from future market performance so you could lose some or all of your investment.]"

columns.name: HAS_CONSUMER_PROTECTION_SCHEME_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element J in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"[However, you may benefit from a consumer protection scheme (see the section ‘what happens if we are unable to pay you’). The indicator shown above does not consider this protection.]"

columns.name: HAS_CPPI_VAL
HAS_CURRENCY_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
PRIIPs Risk Narrative - Element C

A boolean indicator of whether or not a share class is subject to currency risk:

Annex III Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/653, as amended by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1666 states:

// 7. For the purposes of the SRI presentation [...] the following narrative explanations shall be used, as appropriate:

[[Where applicable]: Element C, in bold] Be aware of currency risk. You will receive payments in a different currency, so the final return you will get depend on the exchange rate between the two currencies. This risk is not considered in the indicator shown above.

columns.name: HAS_FURTHER_PAYMENT_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element D in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"In some circumstances you may be required to make further payments for losses. The total loss you may incur may significantly exceed the amount invested".

columns.name: HAS_INCIDENTAL_COSTS_IND
HAS_MINIMUM_GUARANTEED_RETURNS_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of conditional regulatory text for PRIIPs KIDs supplied in Annex III. The regulatory wording is outlined below.

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"There is no minimum guaranteed return. You could lose some or all of your investment".

columns.name: HAS_PERFORMANCE_FEE_VAL
columns.comment: Does the prospectus facilitate a performance fee? If there exists a Performance fee, please fill this field with "yes" and provide respective data in the field "OFST451028 Performance Fee Applied". Otherwise, fill this field with "no" and leave the field "OFST451028 Performance Fee Applied" empty.

columns.name: HAS_RESTRICTIONS_TO_CASH_IN_EARLY_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex V, Element F in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"This product cannot be [easily] cashed in. If you exit the investment earlier than the recommended holding period [you do not have a guarantee](where there is a guarantee only at the recommended holding period) [and] [you [will/may] have to pay extra costs] (where there are exit costs)."

columns.name: HAS_RISK_LIMIT_IND
columns.comment: Please choose 'yes', if the fund has a risk limit. This is quite common for minimum variance portfolios.  Only required where 'Is Flexible' is set to 'Yes'.

columns.name: HAS_WEEKLY_CLOSE_IND
columns.comment: tbc

columns.name: HOLDINGS_DATA_BASED_ON_QUASAR_CD
columns.comment: PMC Field - Either the Fund Code or Scope Code of the Fund on which Holdings should be determined, likely to be the Parent Fund

columns.name: IA_SECTOR_VAL
columns.comment: The IA sectors divide up the funds into smaller groups, to allow you to make like-for-like comparisons between funds in one or more sectors, for instance to look at performance and fund charges.

columns.name: INCIDENTAL_COSTS
columns.comment: The amount (in percentage) of incidental costs charged to end investors in the Fund when the Fund's performance meets certain pre-defined criteria.

columns.name: INDEX_DESC

columns.name: INDEX_DISCLAIMER_NEEDED_VAL

columns.name: INFORMED_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Is this share class suitable to be marketed to an end investor, who can be classified as an 'informed investor'?
An informed investor typically has at least one of the following characteristics:
-- average knowledge of relevant financial products
-- some financial industry experience
Therefore, an informed investor can make an informed investment decision based only on the regulated and authorised offering documentation, together with knowledge and understanding of the specific factors/risks highlighted within them.

columns.name: INTERNAL_USE_IND
columns.comment: Data on this record is for Internal Use Only. Not for external distribution.

columns.name: INV_ASSOC_CD

columns.name: INVESTMENT_MANAGEMENT_AGREEMENT

columns.name: INVESTMENT_OBJECTIVE_DESC
columns.comment: A fund manager´s stated goal for the money invested in his fund, such as capital growth or steady income flows to investors.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE

columns.name: INVESTOR_MINIMUM

columns.name: IRISH_REPORTING_CRRNCY

IS_COST_DEPENDENT_ON_INVESTED_AMOUNT_IND

columns.name: KIDSUK_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION_ADVERSE_CONDITIONS
columns.comment: PMC Description - A PRIIPS KID performance narrative field, which is a component of the KIDs construct and includes  a brief description of what outcome the investor may expect where the product matures or is redeemed or encashed under severely adverse market conditions

columns.name: KIDSUK_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION_COMPARATOR
columns.comment: PMC Description - A PRIIPS KID performance narrative field, which is a component of the KIDs construct which includes a identification of the most relevant index, benchmark, target, or proxy, as applicable, and how the Product is likely to compare in terms of performance and volatility

columns.name: KIDSUK_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION_HIGHER_RETURNS
columns.comment: PMC Description - A PRIIPS KID performance narrative field, which is a component of the KIDs construct which under a sub-heading 'what could affect my return positively?' which includes a brief explanation of the kinds of conditions that would be conducive to the PRIIP generating higher returns

columns.name: KIDSUK_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION_LOWER_RETURNS_OR_LOSS
columns.comment: PMC Description - A PRIIPS KID performance narrative field, which is a component of the KIDs construct under a sub-heading 'what could affect my return negatively?', a brief explanation of the kinds of conditions whereby the PRIIP is likely to generate lower returns or lead to investment loss

columns.name: KIDSUK_PERFORMANCE_INFORMATION_MAIN_FACTORS
columns.comment: PMC Description - A PRIIPS KID performance narrative field, which is a component of the KIDs construct which includes a description of the main factors likely to affect future returns for the investor, identifying those most likely to determine the outcome of the investment and other factors which could have a material impact on performance

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_DATE
columns.comment: Last modification Date and Time in Fundipedia

columns.name: LEAD_QUASAR_REFERENCE
columns.comment: The first 4 -6 digit code used to identify account/sleeve generated within the Quasar, the Fund Accounting System which is linked to the product. Note- multiple accounts could be linked, though this will have the first reference only.

columns.name: LEI
columns.comment: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) for a fund, where this is applicable, i.e. for a FCP. The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code is designed to create a global reference data system that uniquely identifies every legal entity or structure, in any jurisdiction, that is part of a financial transaction. The 2 digit alpha numeric code is constructed as follows: Local Operating Unit (4 characters) - Reserved characters (2) - Entity Identifier (12) - Verification ID (2).

columns.name: LEVERAGED_IND
columns.comment: Is the fund allowed to leverage the fund's asset in order to achieve accelerated returns?

columns.name: LGIM_COMPANY_ID
columns.comment: System generated Unique Fundipedia Company ID for LGIM purposes.

columns.name: LGIM_EUROPE_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.comment: LGIM Europe approval date of supplement

columns.name: LGIM_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: Unique Fundipedia ID for LGIM.

columns.name: LIMITED_CAPITAL_LOSS_LEVEL_VAL
columns.comment: The level of potential losses can be calculated according to the offering documentation. This field is only to be used, if a partial capital guarantee is provided on the primary market and the product is held until the maturity.

columns.name: LIMITED_PARTNERSHIP_AGREEMENT
columns.comment: Hyperlink to the LPA - The foundational legal document for a limited partnership fund, detailing roles, responsibilities, fees, and governance.

columns.name: LIQUIDITY_PARAMETERS
columns.comment: Some Funds will have set liquidity parameters, e.g. how much liquidity the Fund has to hold such as 10% of NAV.

columns.name: LIQUIDITY_RISK_INDICATOR_VAL
columns.comment: PMC Field - An indicator required for PRIIPS kids in relation to the liquidity profile of the fund

columns.name: LIRMS_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.comment: LIRMS Board approval date of supplement

columns.name: LIRMS_SUPPLEMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE
columns.comment: Investment strategies per supplement permitted by the LIRMS Board.

columns.name: LOWER_RANGE_OF_RETURN_TARGET
columns.comment: Lower range of return e.g. if 7%-9% then 7%

columns.name: LTV_LEVERAGE_RATIO
columns.comment: (Loan Amount / Asset Value) * 100

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_FEE_TYPE_ID
columns.comment: The structure of the management fee component of the product or share classes’ pricing structure (i.e. tiered, fixed account size, flat)

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_FEE_TYPE_VAL
columns.comment: The structure of the management fee component of the product or share classes’ pricing structure (i.e. tiered, fixed account size, flat)

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_STYLE
columns.comment: Management style as active or passive

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_PRODUCT_GOVERNANCE_PROCESS_VAL
columns.comment:
An indication of how closely the manufacturer's product governance procedure follows MiFID II.

A = Product governance procedure pursuant to MiFID II 
B = Product governance procedure comparable to MiFID II 
C = Product governance procedure not in accordance with MiFID II 
D = No information is requested from the issuer 

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is:
EMT: 00075_Financial_Instrument_Issuer_Product_Governance_Process. This is an Optional EMT field.//

columns.name: MARKET_MAKER_NAME
columns.comment: Company names performing market making at this stock exchange. Multiple market maker names are separated by pipe '|'' (ASCII 124) as company names may contain commas. Please note that this field is only meaningful for ETFs. Therefore, leave empty for non ETFs. This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST002000(zh-Hant) for Market Maker Name written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

columns.name: MATURITY_DATE_INDICATOR_IND
columns.comment:
Indicates the existence of a contractual maturity date of the portfolio.

//The correspondent PRIIP field introduced by the European Working Group with their PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT) is: EPT: 01125_Has_A_Contractual_Maturity_Date//

columns.name: MAX_DECIMALS_PRICE
columns.comment: Max length of decimal for price

columns.name: MAX_LEVERAGE_LIMIT
columns.comment: Maximum Leverage Limit (Commitment) as disclosed in supplement

columns.name: MAX_LEVERAGE_LIMIT_GROSS
columns.comment: Maximum Leverage Limit (Gross) as disclosed in supplement

columns.name: MAXIMAL_NUMBER_OF_POSSIBLE_DECIMALS_NAV_VAL
columns.comment: Maximal number of decimals used for NAV calculations, assuming that this figure is equal for all kind of NAVs calculated for this specific share class, e.g. valuation price, transaction price (single pricing) or bid and ask price with dual priced share classes.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_REDEMPTION_AS_PERCENTAGE_OF_NAV
columns.comment: Investors will typically be limited in the maximum percentage of the Fund they can redeem before a liquidity management tool is implemented. This is to help protect the Fund's liquidity. E.g. an investor can only redeem a maximum 10% of the Funds NAV before gating etc.

columns.name: MEMBER_COMM_PRICE_SERIES
columns.comment: Hierarchal approach where the Price series used will be the Daily Close (if available and accessible by policyholders), otherwise Daily Midday (if available and accessible by policyholders), otherwise Weekly Close

columns.name: MEMBER_COMM_REPORTING_BASIS_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates whether the Member Comms use a gross or net of fees performance return

columns.name: MEMBER_COMM_TARGET_MARKET_DESC
columns.comment: Describes the suitability of the Fund for schemes and clients. This is presented as 'Who Is This Fund For?' on member comms.

columns.name: MFN_STRATEGY_IND
columns.comment: If yes, this strategy has an active MFN. Most Favoured Nation.

columns.name: MIFID_GER_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_OR_NATURE_VAL
columns.comment:
Classification of products regarding the knowledge and/or experience assessment of distributors.

The translation of each code value is as follows:
01 - Shares
02 - Alternative Investment Fund - fund like UCITS with a physical commodity component
03 - Alternative Investment funds - closed-end funds / closed-end investment funds
04 - Alternative Investment Funds - Open-ended Real Estate Funds
05 - Alternative Investment Funds - Single Hedge Funds
06 - Alternative investment funds - fund of hedge funds
07 - Bonds (unstructured)
08 - Bonds with additional rights / special collateralisation
09 - Bonds with warrants
10 - Additional Tier1 bonds
11 - Profit-sharing rights
12 - Leverage products (factor certificates and ETFs with leverage >1 as per loss reporting, warrants, knock-outs)
13 - UCITS Investment funds (unstructured)
14 - Mining shares
15 - Non-linear CLNs
16 - Reverse products (certificates and ETFs)
17 - Structured investment products (certificates, structured bonds, ETCs)
18 - Structured UCITS and alternative investment funds
19 - Swap-based UCITS and alternative investment funds
20 - Worst-of-certificates
21 - Certificates with Delta 1-depiction of known financial indices
22 - Ancillary rights
24 - Contingent convertibles - bond funds (investment focus AT1)
25 - Tier2 bonds
26 - Senior non-preferred bonds
27 - Alternative investment funds - mixed and other investment funds
28 - Real Estate Investment Trust (REITs)
29 - Miscellaneous
30 - European Long Term Investment Funds (ELTIFs)

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is:
EMT: 00090_Product_Category_or_Nature_Germany. This is a Conditional EMT field.//

columns.name: MIN_HOLDING_PERIOD_DESC
columns.comment: Describes the recommended holding period as appears on factsheets and in KIDs.  Typically 5 years except i) Cash/Money Market Funds (typically no minimum), ii) Real Assets Funds (typically no disclosure on factsheets, but disclosure in KIDs) and iii) where it mirrors the wrap of the underlying.

columns.name: MIN_PERCENTAGE_OF_INVESTMENTS_USED_TO_ATTAIN_ES_CHARACTERISTICS
columns.comment:
The asset allocation planned for this product, to meet the environmental and social
characteristics that it promotes.

columns.name: MINIMUM_PERCENTAGE_INVESTED_IN_ENVIRONMENTALLY_SUSTAINABLE_INVESTMENTS_VAL
columns.comment: Minimum percentage of the portfolio invested in environmentally sustainable investments

columns.name: MINIMUM_PERCENTAGE_INVESTED_IN_SUSTAINABLE_INVESTMENTS_WITH_SOCIAL_OBJECTIVE_VAL
columns.comment: Minimum percentage of the portfolio invested in socially sustainable investments

columns.name: MINIMUM_SUBSCRIPTION_AMT
columns.comment: The minimum amount that clients are required to invest. Private market Funds typically have large minimum subscription amount

columns.name: MULTIPLE_CLOSES
columns.comment: Closed ended funds will have a specified period in which they can raise capital. If there are multiple periods this attribute will confirm this

columns.name: NIS_AVAILABLE_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if NIS (Notional Income Service) is available from the Fund in the weekly close price series

columns.name: NOT_FOR_INVESTORS_WITH_THE_LOWEST_RISK_TOLERANCE_GER_VAL
columns.comment: Please indicate 'yes' in case this share class is not for investors with the lowest risk tolerance. This field is needed for all products distributed in Germany.

columns.name: NT_FA_CD
columns.comment: Fund Accounting code

columns.name: NT_ID
columns.comment: NT generated identifier at shareclass level.

columns.name: ON_FUND_CHARGE_OFC_RATE
columns.comment: On fund charges (OFC) include expenses associated with the fund set-up and ongoing maintenance our funds. Applicable expenses will vary across our fund ranges. On fund charges can include and are not limited to: fund administration, depositary, custody, registration, benchmark license costs, market data and professional fees.

columns.name: ON_FUND_CHARGE_OFC_RATE_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: Effective date of On Fund Charge (OFC) Rate.

columns.name: OPERATING_EXPENSE
columns.comment: The total operating expense for the Fund expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: OTHER_REVIEW_RELATED_TO_VALUE_ANDOR_CHARGES_UK_VAL
columns.comment:
Other review related to value and or charges, either:
A – In line with ESMA supervisory briefing on the supervision of costs in UCITS and AIFs or relevant NCA supervisory activity
O – Other local requirements or procedures
Only used if OFEM090400 EMT Is Assessment of Value Required Under COLL UK is set to "no" and OFEM090600 EMT Outcome of PRIN Value Assessment or Review UK is empty. Out of scope firms may answer this field on a voluntary basis.

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is:
EMT: 09070_Other_Review_Related_To_Value_And_Or_Charges_UK. This is an Optional EMT field.//

columns.name: OTHER_SPECIFIC_INVESTMENT_NEEDS_VAL
columns.comment:
Is the fund designed to meet other specific investment needs such as Islamic banking or other? If the fund does not meet any specific investment needs, please indicate "no".
The following list describes each meaning of the available alphanum values:
N = No
I = Islamic banking
O = Other

columns.name: OUTCOME_OF_PRIN_VALUE_ASSESSMENT_VAL
columns.comment:
Outome of PRIN value assessment or review, either:
1 – product expected to provide fair value for reasonably foreseeable period
2 – review indicates significant changes required in order to provide fair value
Only used if OFEM090500 EMT Outcome of COLL Assessment of Value UK is set to "no". Note PRIN 2A.4.2R, PRIN 2A.4.5R, and PRIN 2A.4.16R. Out of scope firms may answer this field on a voluntary basis.

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is:
EMT: 09060_Outcome_Of_PRIN_Value_Assessment_Or_Review_UK. This is a Conditional EMT field.//

columns.name: OWNER_TEAM_NAME
columns.comment: Team who is responsible within LGIM

columns.name: PAIF_IND
columns.comment: This field is only relevant for UK based funds. If this is not the case, please leave the field empty. Is the fund a Property Authorised Investment Fund (PAIF)? A PAIF is an authorised investment fund primarily invested in property and is a UK regulated fund vehicle. There is no taxation of property profits at fund level. Only eligible investors (e.g. Individual Savings Account, Self Invested Personal Pension) are allowed to invest in PAIF.

columns.name: PARENT_FUND_CD
columns.comment: An identifier used to group funds with similar characteristics.  A “parent” fund is the ‘main’ version of the fund with other funds being ‘iterations’ of it.  Typically the parent fund code is a SCOPE ID of the ‘main’ version of the fund, but alternatively it may be text that describes ‘batches’ of similar funds where it is not appropriate to have a single code as parent e.g. “Single Stock Gilts”

columns.name: PARENT_GROUP_NAME
columns.comment: The main fund name associated with the Parent Fund Code. Typically the heading under which funds are grouped in PMC literatrure

columns.name: PARENT_SUBORDINATE
columns.comment: Used to help define groups funds with similar characteristics.  A “parent” fund is the ‘main’ version of the fund with other funds being ‘iterations’ of it.  Iterations are classified as "sub-ordinate funds".

columns.name: PASSIVE_FUND_IND
columns.comment: Does the fund follow an index very closely?

columns.name: PASSIVE_INVESTMENT_STYLE
columns.comment: This field is exclusively for passive strategies and it defines how the PMs are managing relative to the benchmark.

columns.name: PAY_DATE
columns.comment: The date on which Income is paid in a respective Fund

columns.name: PERFORMANCE_BENCHMARK_TAX_CAVEAT
columns.comment: A statement required for factsheets with regards to the tax status of the benchmark being used vs the tax treatment of the fund

columns.name: PERFORMANCE_FEE
columns.comment: For PMC Funds this is the performance fee levied by PMC, for PMC wrapped funds it does not take into account any exit charge levied by the underlying fund.

columns.name: PRICE_TYPE
columns.comment: Details the type of pricing used by the Fund.

columns.name: PRICING_METHODOLOGY
columns.comment:
In general there are "Dual Pricing Funds" and "Single Pricing Funds"._x000D_
_x000D_
The value "dual pricing" refers to a fund, which calculates two NAVs, firstly the so-called "offer price", a NAV for subscribers derived from underlying security offer prices and secondly the so-called "bid price", a NAV for redeemers, derived from underlying security bid prices._x000D_
_x000D_
A "single pricing" fund calculates only one single NAV per share, which is used for all capital activities regardless whether inflows or outflows are affected. However there are three different main methods for calculating the single NAV. Therefore, if it is a single pricing fund, please also fill out field "OFST401003 Single Pricing Type".
Values - "single pricing" ; "dual pricing"

columns.name: PRIIPS_CATEGORY_VAL
columns.comment:
PRIIP Category of the Portfolio as outlined in the Regularly Technical Standards (RTS) of Regulation (EU) No 1286/2014 in Annex 2, numbers 4-7.

//This field was introduced by the European Working Group with their PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT).
EPT: 00080_Portfolio_PRIIPS_Category
and the corresponding field to the CEPT (addition to the EPT) is:
CEPT-RHPs: 30070_Portfolio_PRIIPS_Category//

columns.name: PRIIPS_KID_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if a PRIIPS KID is produced. KIDS are a point of sale document which must be made available to any retail classified policyholder.

columns.name: PRIIPS_KID_INVESTMENT_DESC
columns.comment: Narrative text outlining the rules and policies that govern the Product and how investments can be made by its share or unit classes. This version of the investment policy is included in the PRIIPs KID.

columns.name: PRIIPS_REFERENCE_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT_VAL
columns.comment: The recommended minimum investment amount in the currency of the Share Class to be displayed in the PRIIPs KID.

columns.name: PRIVATE_MARKETS_PRODUCT_IND
columns.comment: Flags whether the product is a Private Markets Products. Define as: This is a flag to idenfify products that are managed by the Private Market Product Team

columns.name: PRODUCT_BENCHMARK_CAVEATS
columns.comment: PMC Definition: A free text field which is used to provide further clarity around the benchmark, particularly on factsheets where an abbreviated name is used.

columns.name: PRODUCT_BENCHMARK_NAME_FOR_FACTSHEETS
columns.comment: PMC Definition: An abbreviated version of the benchmark full name which is used for Factsheets and other areas where a character restriction applies

columns.name: PRODUCT_BENCHMARK_TYPE
columns.comment: PMC Field: Defines how the benchmark is used for performance monitoring purposes i.e. whether it is a formal benchmark which performance is measured against, an indicative comparator or a reference index for illustrative purposes.  Used in conjunction with the Investment Objective, primarily in the construction of factsheets.

columns.name: PRODUCT_BENCHMARK_TYPE_INDEX_FUNDS_VAL
columns.comment: Defines how the benchmark is used for performance monitoring purposes i.e. whether it is a formal benchmark which performance is measured against, an indicative comparator or a reference index for illustrative purposes.  Used in conjunction with the Investment Objective, primarily in the construction of factsheets.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CRRNCY_CD

columns.name: PRODUCT_LAUNCH_DATE
columns.comment: The date on which the product received its first subscription. Date in which client/fund opens. The date should be displayed in US format for LGIMA or  in the respective country format.

columns.name: PRODUCT_LEGAL_NAME

columns.name: PRODUCT_MEETS_CLIMATE_TRANSITION_BENCHMARK_LIST_EXCLUSIONARY_REQUIREMENTS_VAL

columns.name: PRODUCT_MEETS_PARIS_ALIGNED_BENCHMARK_EXCLUSIONARY_REQUIREMENTS_VAL

columns.name: PRODUCT_NAME

columns.name: PRODUCT_PRICE_BASIS
columns.comment: Details the type of pricing used by the Fund.

columns.name: PRODUCT_REVIEW_DATE
columns.comment: Date that the PMC wrap of the external manager fund was last internally reviewed

columns.name: PRODUCT_SHORT_CD
columns.comment: A short-form or acronym used internally to refer to the fund

columns.name: PRODUCT_SHORT_NAME
columns.comment: Abbreviated investment vehicle legal name

columns.name: PRODUCT_STATUS
columns.comment: PMC Definition: Indicates if the Fund is Open, Closed, Closing or Pending Launch

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comment:
"Is the fund Complex or Standard? A fund is considered as Standard if all the following conditions are met:
- Fund with an official ISIN
- Fund which do not require specific documentation to be submitted to the transfer agent prior to each subsequent trade
- Fund which do not authorize partial redemption
- Fund with performance fees taken out of the NAV
A fund is considered as Complex if any of the above criteria for Standard Funds is not met"

columns.name: PRODUCT_WITHOUT_RETROCESSION_VAL
columns.comment:
Indicates whether the share class pays any inducement in the context of MiFID II.

yes - The share class does not pay any inducement
no - The share class does pay inducement

// The correspondent MiFID II field introduced by the European Working Group with their MiFID Data Dictionary Template (EMT) is:
EMT: 00110_Fund_Share_Class_Without_Retrocession. This is an Indicative EMT field.//

columns.name: PROFESSIONAL_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Might this share class from a producer's perspective being marketed to a professional?
Under MiFID regulation, a professional investor is regarded to have the experience, knowledge and expertise to take investment decisions by its own. Therefore, from a target market point of view, if "OFEM010100 EMT Client Type Retail" was answered with "yes", usually this field should be answered with "yes", too.

yes - both Professional Per Se and Elective Professionals are compatible.
no - neither Professional Per Se nor Elective Professionals are compatible.
professional per se - Professional Per Se is compatible but Elective Professionals are not (this is only used if the distinction "Per Se" is made in the Prospectus)
elective professional - Elective Professional is compatible but Professionals Per Se are not.

columns.name: RECOMMENDED_HOLDING_PERIOD_VAL
columns.comment: The Recommended Holding Period (RHP) represents the view of the PRIIP manufacturer regarding a recommended period of time for a retail investor to hold the product. The RHP is also used as part of the calculation process of some of the metrics displayed within PRIIPs material (e.g. the KID).

columns.name: REDEMPTION_WINDOW_MONTH

columns.name: REDEMPTION_WINDOW_PERIOD
columns.comment: Investors can typically only request to redeem their holdings in certain liquidity windows. E.g. every quarter. This will be the period

columns.name: REDEMPTIONS_ALLOWED
columns.comment: Closed ended Funds will not typically allow redemptions prior to the Funds end date.

columns.name: REGULATOR_CSSF_ID
columns.comment: A unique identifier assigned by the CSSF (Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier) regulator to the Product. The authority responsible for regulating and overseeing the professionals and products of the Luxembourg financial market.

columns.name: REGULATOR_FCA_ID
columns.comment: A unique identifier assigned by the FCA (Financial Conduct Authority) regulator to the Product. The authority responsible for regulating and overseeing certain aspects of financial markets and institutions.

columns.name: REPLICATION_METHODOLOGY_FIRST_LEVEL
columns.comment: Replication methodology for ETFs or passive funds. This field is linked to OFST191 Replication Methodology Second Level, that specifies the details of this field. Please note, that one can use this field (OFST19) without completing field OFST191 Replication Methodology Second Level, whereas this is not possible for the other way around.

columns.name: REPLICATION_METHODOLOGY_FIRST_LEVEL_VAL
columns.comment:
Replication methodology for ETFs or passive funds. This field is linked to OFST191 Replication Methodology Second Level, that specifies the details of this field. Please note, that one can use this field (OFST19) without completing field OFST191 Replication Methodology Second Level, whereas this is not possible for the other way around.
Values for Replication Methodology First Level would be "physical" ; "synthetical" ; "others"

columns.name: RESPONSIBLE_OWNER_OF_OPERATING_EXPENSES
columns.comment: Which party is responsible for paying operating expenses

columns.name: RETAIL_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment: Might this share class from a producer's perspective being marketed to a retail investor no matter, if the investor has only basic knowledge ("OFEM020100 EMT Investor With Basic Knowledge" = yes) or if he is an informed investor ("OFEM020200 EMT Informed Investor" = yes) or is an advanced investor ("OFEM020300 EMT Advanced Investor" = yes)?

columns.name: RETURN_PROFILE_GER_PENSION_SCHEME_VAL
columns.comment: According to rule from the EMT, please use the value "yes" for funds used in German pension contracts, such as Riester and Rürup. For funds with performance fees, please use "neutral" or "no". For other funds, "yes" or "neutral" should be used.

columns.name: RETURN_PROFILE_GROWTH_VAL
columns.comment: May a fund distributor sell this fund to an end investor, whose return profile is 'capital growth'?

columns.name: RETURN_PROFILE_INCOME_VAL
columns.comment: May a fund distributor sell this fund to an end investor, whose return profile is 'income'?

columns.name: RETURN_PROFILE_OPTIONS_OR_LEVERAGE_VAL
columns.comment: May a fund distributor sell this fund to an end investor, whose investment strategy is very aggressive?

columns.name: RETURN_PROFILE_PRESERVATION_VAL
columns.comment: May a fund distributor sell this fund to an end investor, whose return profile is 'capital preservation'?

columns.name: REVIEW_DATE_OF_UNDERLYING_EXTERNAL_PRODUCT_DISCLOSED_EXPENSES
columns.comment: The date of the last review of the external manager expenses.

columns.name: RTG_FITCH
columns.comment: Measures the ability of a fund or issuer to repay debt, highlighting credit risk.

columns.name: RTG_MOODY
columns.comment: Assesses the credit risk of a fund or issuer, focusing on the probability of default and expected financial loss.

columns.name: RTG_SP
columns.comment: S&P (Standard & Poor’s) Fund Rating. Evaluates the creditworthiness of a fund or issuer, indicating the likelihood they will meet their financial obligations.

columns.name: SALESFORCE_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: This field is named “Product Master: ID” in Salesforce – this is auto generated unique ID, and is assigned to each product in Salesforce (e.g., SEGs, CITs, LLC, and Mutual Funds).  An example of this ID, a0F4U00000LgJAD.

columns.name: SCOPE_DEALING_RESTRICTIONS
columns.comment: PMC Field - this field details any internal notes that have been applied to SCOPE in respect of any dealing restrictions that may be applied to investors

columns.name: SCOPE_HOLDING_RESTRICTIONS
columns.comment: PMC Field - this field details any internal notes that have been applied to SCOPE in respect of any restrictions that may be applied to certain types of investors

columns.name: SCOPE_PRODUCT_CD
columns.comment: A SCOPE system fund identifier consisting of one, two or four letters

columns.name: SDR_SUSTAINABILITY_LABEL
columns.comment: Defines which of the SDR Sustainability Labels the fund is authorised to use. UK’s Sustainability Disclosure Requirements (SDR) defines four labels that funds can use, with specific requirements for each label.

columns.name: SEDOL
columns.comment: A dummy SEDOL code which is displayed on factsheets for Workplace funds

columns.name: SEED_DATE
columns.comment: Date in which client/fund first invests

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PERIOD_FOR_REDEMPTIONS
columns.comment: How many days are needed to settle a redemption of this fund after the closing/valuation date, i.e. how many days does it take after valuation until the cash is transferred to the sellers account ? Please choose calendar or business days in field "OFST430200 Calendar Or Business Days For Transactions".

columns.name: SETTLEMENT_PERIOD_FOR_SUBSCRIPTIONS
columns.comment: The number of days after the trade date on which subscriptions settle.                                                                                                                PMC Defintion - The number of days after the trade date on which PMC pays the underlying manager

columns.name: SFDR_CLASSIFICATION
columns.comment: The classification of the Fund in relation to the SFDR Directive. Classifications are categorised based on How ESG is   integrated into the Fund.

columns.name: SHAREHOLDER_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates whether investors invest in the sub-fund directly, via a PMC or both

columns.name: SPREAD_ANTI_DILUTION_LEVY_BID
columns.comment: Protects existing investors from the costs incurred due to large inflows or outflows of money into or out of the fund.

columns.name: SPREAD_ANTI_DILUTION_LEVY_DATE
columns.comment: Effective date of Spread / Anti Dilution Levy

columns.name: SPREAD_ANTI_DILUTION_LEVY_OFFER
columns.comment: Protects existing investors from the costs incurred due to large inflows or outflows of money into or out of the fund.

columns.name: SPREAD_ANTI_DILUTION_LEVY_ROUND_TRIP
columns.comment: Protects existing investors from the costs incurred due to large inflows or outflows of money into or out of the fund.

columns.name: SRI
columns.comment: PMC field: Summary Risk Indicator (SRI) is a standardized risk indicator under PRIIPS regulation that considers both the volatility of a financial instrument (market risk) and the creditworthiness of the issuer (credit risk). It is displayed as a number between 1 and 7, representing the combined risk of the product.

columns.name: SRRI
columns.comment: The Synthetic Risk and Reward Indicator (SRRI) demonstrates the relative risk and reward profile of the fund.  Used for Workplace Funds only and displayed on their factsheet.

columns.name: SUB_GROUPING_VAL
columns.comment: Further granularity of the asset types within the Fund's investment profile

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_CRRNCY
columns.comment: The currency that investors use to subscribe to the Fund. The majority of Funds are either £ or €

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_FREQUENCY
columns.comment: The timeframes in which investors can subscribe. E.g. there is an annual window whereby investors can subscribe. For closed ended Funds this will likely be a finite period.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_METHOD
columns.comment: Method by which investors subscribe / invest capital into the Fund

columns.name: SYSTEM_BENCHMARK_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia assigned code specific to the Benchmark. This code is unique at Benchmark level only. (This is a primary key to link Product and Benchmark)

columns.name: SYSTEM_STRATEGY_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia assigned code specific to the Product. This code is unique at Product level only. (This is a primary key to link tables to Product)

columns.name: SYSTEM_UMBRELLA_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia assigned code specific to the umbrella. This code is unique at umbrella level only. (This is a primary key to link Product and Umbrella)

columns.name: TARGET_MARKET_DESC
columns.comment: Describes the suitability of the Fund for schemes and clients. This is presented as 'Who Is This Fund For?' on the Fact Sheet and the "Intended Retail Investor" section of KIDS.

columns.name: TARGET_RETURN_TYPE
columns.comment: The target return type of the Fund. This can either be where the Fund has a formal benchmark or uses a performance metric, such as IRR.

columns.name: TIER_1_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 1 Bps is used in determining the management fee. If not populated, Tier 1 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels.

columns.name: TIER_2_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 2 Bps is used in determining the management fee, applicable to accounts larger than Tier 1 MV. If not populated, Tier 2 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels above Tier 1 MV.

columns.name: TIER_3_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 3 Bps is used in determining the management fee, applicable to accounts larger than the sum of previous Tiers. If not populated, Tier 3 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels above the sum of previous tiers.

columns.name: TIER_4_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 4 Bps is used in determining the management fee, applicable to accounts larger than the sum of previous Tiers. If not populated, Tier 4 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels above the sum of previous tiers.

columns.name: TIER_5_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 5 Bps is used in determining the management fee, applicable to accounts larger than the sum of previous Tiers. If not populated, Tier 5 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels above the sum of previous tiers.

columns.name: TIER_6_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 6 Bps is used in determining the management fee, applicable to accounts larger than the sum of previous Tiers. If not populated, Tier 6 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels above the sum of previous tiers.

columns.name: TIER_7_MV
columns.comment: The market value (in [$]M) break point for which Tier 7 Bps is used in determining the management fee, applicable to accounts larger than the sum of previous Tiers. If not populated, Tier 7 Bps is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels above the sum of previous tiers.

columns.name: TOTAL_EXPENSE_RATIO
columns.comment: A measure of the total costs  associated with managing and operating an investment fund against the value of the fund's total assets.

columns.name: TPA_FAND_CD
columns.comment: CITI generated identifier at Product level.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_EU_DIRECTIVE
columns.comment: Indicates, whether the fund is an UCITS as outlined in EU Directives 2009/65/EC or an AIF as described in the Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive 2011/61/EU

columns.name: UCITS_ELIGIBILITY_IND
columns.comment: Indicates whether the shares or units in the CIS (fund) are eligible to be held by a UCITS.

columns.name: UCITS_GLOBAL_EXPOSURE_LIMIT
columns.comment: Indicates the global exposure limit the product must adhere to.

columns.name: UCITS_GLOBAL_EXPOSURE_TYPE_VAL
columns.comment:
Calculation methodology used to measure global exposure. Global exposure, as referred to in Article 51(3) of the UCITS Directive, is a measure designed to limit either the incremental exposure and leverage generated by a UCITS through the use of financial derivative instruments (including embedded derivatives) or the market risk of the UCITS portfolio. 
Incremental exposure and leverage are more precisely linked to UCITS utilising the commitment approach and that global exposure for UCITS using a VaR approach is linked to market risk.

columns.name: UCITS_KIID_INVESTMENT_DESC
columns.comment: Narrative text outlining the rules and policies that govern the Product and how investments can be made by its share or unit classes. This version of the investment policy is included in the UCITS KIID.

columns.name: UCITS_KIID_SFDR_CLASSIFICATION
columns.comment: The SFDR sub-classification the Fund falls into. This is used as a marker to indicate the relevant narrative to be included in the UCITS KIID

columns.name: UK_FACTSHEET_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if a UK Fact Sheet is produced for the Fund. Please note that PMC are not required to produce factsheets. Fund Reporting Team need to agree to support factsheet production.

columns.name: UK_FUND_CENTRE_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if the fund appears on the UK Fund Centre website.

columns.name: UK_NET_CHARGES_FACTSHEET_IND
columns.comment: Indicates if a net of charges factsheet (typically produced for UK DC schemes) is produced for the Fund

columns.name: UK_PRIIP_OR_UCITS_OR_BOTH_DATA_DELIVERY_VAL
columns.comment:
Indicates if the record contains UK PRIIPs data, UCITS data or Both. This field is only required if providing some UK data in the delivery, otherwise it can be left blank.

//The correspondent PRIIP field introduced by FinDatEx with their European PRIIPS Template v2.1 (EPT) is: EPT: 08010_UK_PRIIP_Or_UCITS_Or_Both_data_delivery//

columns.name: UK_REPORTING_CRRNCY
columns.comment: The currency which is used for reporting purposes on UK factsheets and on the fund centre. NB not the same as base currency which is always GBP for PMC.

columns.name: UK_UCITS_FUND_IND
columns.comment: Is the fund a UK-authorised UCITS? Such funds are UK-domiciled funds that would have had the value 'UCITS' in field OFST160040 Type of EU Directive prior to the Implementation Period Completion Day (IPCD) of the withdrawal of the United Kingdom (UK) from the European Union (EU), and should have the value 'AIF' in that field post-IPCD. The IPCD is defined in the EU (Withdrawal Agreement) Act 2020 as 31 December 2020 at 11pm (https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2020/1/contents/enacted).

columns.name: UNDERLYING_EXTERNAL_PRODUCT_DISCLOSED_ADDITIONAL_EXPENSES_NOT_INCLUDE_PER
columns.comment: The Additional Expense rate as disclosed by the External Manager at a given date confirmed in last expenses reviewed field. Please refer to the field 'Underlying External Product Disclosed Expenses Additional Info'. Other fees may apply.

columns.name: UNDERLYING_EXTERNAL_PRODUCT_DISCLOSED_EXPENSES_ADDITIONAL_INFO
columns.comment: Additional expense information disclosed by the External Manager that is not captured under AMC, Additional Expenses or Property Expenses.

columns.name: UNDERLYING_EXTERNAL_PRODUCT_DISCLOSED_PROPERTY_EXPENSES_APPLICABLE
columns.comment: The Property Expenses as disclosed by the External Manager at a given date confirmed in last expenses reviewed field. Please refer to the field 'Underlying External Product Disclosed Expenses Additional Info'. Other fees may apply.

columns.name: UNDERLYING_PRODUCT_STRUCTURE
columns.comment: PMC Defintion - The legal structure of the underlying fund.

columns.name: UPPER_RANGE_OF_RETURN_TARGET
columns.comment: Higher range of return e.g. if 7%-9% then 9%

columns.name: VALUATION_FREQ
columns.comment: Interval between the valuation of the fund

columns.name: VALUATION_POINT
columns.comment: The valuation time at which the NAV of the fund is calculated. Please also indicate the Time Zone in the field "OFST1251 Fund Valuation Point Time Zone".

columns.name: VALUE_FOR_MONEY_FURTHER_INFORMATION
columns.comment:
Link to sources of relevant information. This may provide a link to information to explain a "2" in fields OFEM090500 or OFEM090600 and may be used to explain OFEM090700 further.

For example, a hyperlink to the COLL assessment of value report, other relevant information, relevant NCA website, or an email address.

columns.name: CALL_FEATURE
columns.comment: Provides the number of times in any given year the call option can be exercised. In the case of a bond where the call can only be exercised once in its lifetime, onetime is returned.  In the case of a bond where the call option can be exercised on any unspecified date, anytime is returned. For securities callable on an irregular basis or with multi-year frequencies (i.e. 5 year frequency) the field will return a null value.

columns.name: CALL_FREQ
columns.comment: The number of times per year a call can be exercised.        A return of '0' is applicable on securities that are either:    1. continuously callable, (DX037, Call Feature = Anytime) or     2. is callable once, (DX037, Call Feature = Onetime) or    3. has a multi-year frequency (i.e. 5 year frequency)    4. is callable on an irregular basis (bi-weekly, dates without a pattern)
