columns.name: FIRM_CORP_ACT_MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The market value for the specific corporate action in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_INC_PAYMT_GROSS
columns.comment: The gross income payment before any tax is deducted in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_INC_PAYMT_NET
columns.comment: The net income payment after the tax is deducted for the transaction in firm currency. This net income payment is the gross income less withheld taxes whether they are reclaimable or not reclaimable.

columns.name: FIRM_INT_BOUGHT_SOLD
columns.comment: The amount of accrued interest associated with the transaction in the firm currency of the transaction.

columns.name: FIRM_ORIG_COST
columns.comment: The original cost of the asset in firm currency. The corporate event transactions show the cost impact.

columns.name: FIRM_PRIN_AMT
columns.comment: The principal amount of the trade in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_PROCEEDS
columns.comment: The proceeds of sales transactions in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_RGL_TOT
columns.comment: The total realized gain or loss on the transaction in firm currency.

columns.name: FX_RATE
columns.comment: The exchange rate from the local currency of the security to the firm currency of the transaction.

columns.name: INC_REASON
columns.comment: The reason code attributed to the income on the transaction.

columns.name: INC_SETTLE_AMT
columns.comment: Traded interest in the settlement currency.

columns.name: INC_SETTLE_CRRNCY
columns.comment: The Settlement Currency for the Income.

columns.name: ISSUER_CD
columns.comment: Code representing the issuer / counterparty. Code defined in DIM_ISSUER as ISSUER_CD.

columns.name: LEDGER_DATE
columns.comment: The effective date of the transaction.

columns.name: LOC_BKR_COMM_AMT
columns.comment: The commission paid to the broker on this transaction in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_CASH_PAYBL_RECVB
columns.comment: The transaction settlement amount in the settlement currency.

columns.name: LOC_CORP_ACT_MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The market value for the specific corporate action in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_INC_PAYMT_GROSS
columns.comment: The gross income payment before any tax is deducted in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_INC_PAYMT_NET
columns.comment: The net income payment after the tax is deducted for the transaction in local currency. This is the gross income less withheld taxes whether they are reclaimable or not reclaimable.

columns.name: LOC_INT_BOUGHT_SOLD
columns.comment: The amount of accrued interest associated with the transaction in the local currency.

columns.name: LOC_PRIN_AMT
columns.comment: The principal amount of the trade in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_PROCEEDS
columns.comment: The proceeds of sales transactions in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_RGL_TOT
columns.comment: The total realized gain or loss on the transaction in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_WTHLD_DTAX_NONRECLM
columns.comment: The portion of the domestic tax withheld that is not eligible to reclaim in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_WTHLD_TAX_NONRECLM
columns.comment: The portion of the foreign tax withheld that is not eligible to reclaim in local currency.

columns.name: LONG_SHT_CD
columns.comment: The long/short code. Valid values: L - Long, S - Short.

columns.name: LONG_SHT_DESC
columns.comment: The long/short description.

columns.name: NET_PRIN_AMT
columns.comment: Net cash amount in the principal local currency

columns.name: NET_PRIN_SETTLE_AMT
columns.comment: Net cash amount in settlement currency

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.comment: Order Identifier from the order generating system.

columns.name: ORIG_COST_CHG
columns.comment: The change to the original cost of the position or tax lot in base currency.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comment: The identifier that links the transaction at the sleeve level to the parent transaction.

columns.name: PRIN_SETTLE_CRRNCY
columns.comment: The Settlement Currency Code for the principal

columns.name: PRIN_SETTLE_CRRNCY_DESC
columns.comment: The Settlement Currency Description for the principal

columns.name: PRVDR_NAME
columns.comment: The name  describing the provider.

columns.name: QTY_CHG
columns.comment: Changes in quantity (number of units) resulting from a transaction event

columns.name: RELATED_SEC_ID
columns.comment: Related Security Identifier

columns.name: RELATED_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comment: The transaction identifier for the associated contact swap security transaction.

columns.name: REPLACED_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comment: The identifier on the original transaction that has been replaced by this transaction.

columns.name: SEC_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of the security. Identifier defined in DIM_SECURITY as SEC_ID.

columns.name: SETT_CRRNCY_CD
columns.comment: The code representing the currency in which the transaction will be settled. This code is ISO compliant.

columns.name: SETT_CRRNCY_DESC
columns.comment: The description representing the currency in which the transaction will be settled. This code is ISO compliant.

columns.name: SETT_IND
columns.comment: Code defining whether the trade has settled. S - settled, N - not settled, NULL - no cash settlement is involved.

columns.name: SETTLE_DATE
columns.comment: The date the transaction is scheduled to settle per the contractual agreement between parties. The transfer of agreed upon assets or currency is complete.

columns.name: SRC_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.comment: The original transaction ID from the source system.

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.comment: The code for the post status of the transaction.

columns.name: STATUS_DESC
columns.comment: Description of code for the post status of the transaction

columns.name: TRACK_CD
columns.comment: A tracker code means the transaction has been previously sent to the client on an extract.

columns.name: TRADE_DATE
columns.comment: The trade date is when an order to purchase, sell or otherwise acquire a security is executed.

columns.name: TRADE_ID
columns.comment: The unique trade identifier

columns.name: TRADE_STAMP_DATETIME
columns.comment: Transaction trading date

columns.name: TRADING_VENUE
columns.comment: Trading Venue.  For cases where broker is used as a trading venue, codes defined in DIM_BROKER as BKR_CD, BIC, LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER, MIC. For cases where exchange is used as a trading venue, codes defined in DIM_EXCHANGE as EXCH_CD, ISO_EXCH_CD.

columns.name: TRD_VENDOR_SRC_NAME
columns.comment: The name associated with the vendor of the transaction.

columns.name: TXN_CAT_CD
columns.comment: Transaction category code

columns.name: TXN_CAT_CUSTOM
columns.comment: The custom category code used for the transaction to indicate the type of transaction.

columns.name: TXN_CAT_DESC
columns.comment: Transaction category. Code defined in DIM_CODE_VALUE as DESC_CD where DESC_TYPE = 'TXNCAT'.

columns.name: TXN_CAT_NAME
columns.comment: The category name used for the transaction to indicate the type of transaction.

columns.name: TXN_DATE
columns.comment: The date the transaction was executed.

columns.name: TXN_ORIG_TYPE_CD
columns.comment: The code received from the source system representing the transaction type. Source system equivalent of the normalized TXN_TYPE_CD. If available, code defined in DIM_CODE_VALUE as DESC_CD where DESC_TYPE = 'TXNORIGTYP'.

columns.name: TXN_ORIG_TYPE_DESC
columns.comment: Description of Code representing the original type of the transaction.

columns.name: TXN_SRC_CD
columns.comment: Code defining activity generating the transaction (ex. Trades, Position Recon, Bank Balance, Cash Flow).

columns.name: TXN_SRC_DESC
columns.comment: Description defining activity generating the transaction (ex. Trades, Position Recon, Bank Balance, Cash Flow).

columns.name: TXN_TYPE_CD
columns.comment: Code representing the type of the transaction. This is a normalized code i.e. code is provider and service agnostic.

columns.name: TXN_TYPE_DESC
columns.comment: Description of Code representing the type of the transaction.

columns.name: SYSTEM_UMBRELLA_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia assigned code specific to the Umbrella. This code is unique at Umbrella level only. (This is a primary key to link tables to Umbrella table)

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: Service Code defining the data provider

columns.name: AS_OF_DATE
columns.comment: Business Date of Data Snapshot

columns.name: ADMINISTRATOR_NAME
columns.comment: Fund administrator that confirms fund documentation is in good order, account is open and operationally ready for funding.

columns.name: AUDITOR_ADDRESS
columns.comment: Official address of auditor for documentation purposes

columns.name: AUDITOR_NAME
columns.comment: Third party acting as auditor for the umbrella company

columns.name: AUTHORISED_CORPORATE_DIRECTOR_NAME
columns.comment: For Unit Trusts, this is the same as the Authorised Fund Manager (AFM).

columns.name: CBI_APPROVED_IND
columns.comment: Is the fund approved by the Central Bank of Ireland?

columns.name: CBI_UMBRELLA_REFERENCE
columns.comment: Central Bank of Ireland (Irish Regulator) code for Fund Umbrella

columns.name: CSSF_APPROVED_IND
columns.comment: Is the fund approved by CSSF (Luxembourg Regulator)

columns.name: CUSTODIAN_BANK_ADDRESS
columns.comment: The official address of the custodian bank.

columns.name: CUSTODIAN_NAME
columns.comment:
Name of custodian bank as listed in official documents (i.e. prospectus)._x000D_
_x000D_
This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST14(zh-Hant) for Custodian Bank Name written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

columns.name: DEPOSITARY_ADDRESS
columns.comment: The registered address of the appointed depositary

columns.name: DEPOSITARY_NAME
columns.comment: The depositary is the entity appointed to act in a safekeeping and a fiduciary capacity for the  collective investment scheme (fund), as well as providing global custody services.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTOR_NAME
columns.comment: Organization that will act as the distributor for the funds

columns.name: DOMICILE_COUNTRY_NAME
columns.comment: Domicile of the Umbrella. Please use ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 code (i.e. SE for Sweden). A code that identifies the country where a Fund is legally registered and carries out its main business function.

columns.name: DOMICILE_OF_MAN_CO
columns.comment: Domicile of the ManCo. Please use ISO 3166-1-alpha-2 code

columns.name: ETF_IND
columns.comment: Is the share class an Exchange Traded Fund (ETF)? This field is on share class level as there are funds having both  ETFs and non-ETFs as share classes.

columns.name: FCA_AUTHORISED_IND
columns.comment:
Is the fund authorised by the FCA (Financial Conduct Authority, a UK financial regulatory body responsible for regulation of conduct by both retail and wholesale financial services firms)?_x000D_
_x000D_
An authorised fund, which may also be called an "authorised CIS", must be established in the UK and take one of the following legal forms:_x000D_
- authorised contractual scheme (ACS)_x000D_
- authorised unit trust (AUT)_x000D_
- investment company with variable capital (ICVC)_x000D_
_x000D_
It must also be classified, based on a marketing strategy, as one of the following:_x000D_
- undertaking for collective investment in transferable securities scheme (UCITS)_x000D_
- non-UCITS retail scheme (NURS)_x000D_
- qualified investor scheme (QIS)

columns.name: FCA_UMBRELLA_ID
columns.comment: The identifier used by the FCA.

columns.name: FISCAL_REPORTING_DATE
columns.comment: Fiscal year end of fund.

columns.name: FUND_ACCOUNTANT_NAME
columns.comment: The responsible party for the aspects of day-to-day accounting of a Fund including the calculating and releasing of Fund Prices.

columns.name: FUND_ADVISOR_NAME
columns.comment:
Name of the Company (or Companies) that support(s) the Portfolio Managing Company (OFST001450) by giving advice, if any. Please note, that no such advisor exists in most cases. Very seldom the advisor is the main investment decision taker. In this case "OFST001450 Portfolio Managing Company Name" and this field should contain the same name. This field can have multiple values, which should be given separated by a pipe "|" (ASCII 124) symbol._x000D_
_x000D_
This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST001500(zh-Hant) for Fund Advisor Name written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

columns.name: FUND_GROUP_NAME
columns.comment: Overall brand name of the fund company. Not necessarily identical with the management company's (OFST001020 ManCo) name.

columns.name: INVESTMENT_MANAGER_NAME
columns.comment: The name of the entity responsible for managing the fund/portfolio in accordance with mandate set out in accordance with the Investment Management Agreement with the Manager/ACD/ManCo.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_DATE
columns.comment: Last Modified Date

columns.name: LEGAL_ADVISOR_ADDRESS
columns.comment: This is the registered address of the legal advisor

columns.name: LEGAL_ADVISOR_NAME
columns.comment: This is the law firm that provide advice in the local jurisdiction where the fund is registered

columns.name: LEI_OF_MAN_CO
columns.comment: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) for the company entity ("ManCo OFST001020"). The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code is designed to create a global reference data system that uniquely identifies every legal entity or structure, in any jurisdiction, that is part of a financial transaction. The 20 digit alpha numeric code is constructed as follows: Local Operating Unit (4 characters) - Reserved characters (2) - Entity Identifier (12) - Verification ID (2).

columns.name: LGIM_UMBRELLA_ID
columns.comment: Unique Fundipedia ID for LGIM.

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_COMPANY_ADDRESS
columns.comment: Address of the registered Management Company for the Umbrella

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_COMPANY_NAME
columns.comment:
The name of the legal entity that is in charge of managing the fund (this includes, in general, portfolio management, administration and distribution). A common fund (FCP) must be managed by a Management Company. For a self-managed SICAV it is the name of the SICAV itself. Other terms are "KVG", "Fondsleitung" or "Investment Company"._x000D_
This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST12(zh-Hant) for ManCo written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

columns.name: NURS_IND
columns.comment:
This field is only relevant for UK based funds. If this is not the case, please leave the field blank.

Is the fund a Non-UCITS Retails Scheme (NURS)? A NURS is a fund, which is neither a UCITS scheme nor a qualified investor scheme according to the UK Financial Conduct Authority.

columns.name: OPEN_OR_CLOSE_ENDED
columns.comment: Is it possible to subscribe or redeem shares of the fund on a regular basis, i.e. daily? If yes, it is an open-ended fund. If no, it is a closed-ended fund

columns.name: REGISTERED_OFFICE
columns.comment: The registered office of the Fund Umbrella.

columns.name: REGISTRAR_NAME
columns.comment: Registrar is also typically Transfer Agent for the sub-fund. This can be found in the Fund Prospectus.

columns.name: REGULATOR_CSSF_ID
columns.comment: A unique identifier assigned by the CSSF (Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier) regulator to the Product. The authority responsible for regulating and overseeing the professionals and products of the Luxembourg financial market.

columns.name: REGULATOR_NAME
columns.comment: The Regulator for the Fund Umbrella.

columns.name: STANDALONE_IND
columns.comment: Is the Fund a Standalone Trust or a sub Fund of an umbrella?

columns.name: STRUCTURED_UCITS_IND
columns.comment:
Is the fund a structured UCITS according to Section 36 of EU Regulation 583/2010?  Choose "yes" only if the value of "OFST160040 Type Of EU Directive" is "UCITS". For all other cases choose "no".
For the purposes of this section, structured UCITS shall be understood as UCITS which provide investors, at certain predetermined dates, with algorithm-based payoffs that are linked to the performance, or to the realisation of price changes or other conditions, of financial assets, indices or reference portfolios or UCITS with similar features.

For more information please consider https://eur-lex.europa.eu/LexUriServ/LexUriServ.do?uri=OJ:L:2010:176:0001:0015:en:PDF

This field applies only if the value of "OFST160040 Type Of EU Directive" is "UCITS".

columns.name: TRANSFER_AGENT_NAME
columns.comment:
Name of the transfer agent._x000D_
_x000D_
This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST002700(zh-Hant) for Transfer Agent Name written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

columns.name: TRUSTEE_NAME
columns.comment: Institution appointed to manage assets for client - Citibank

columns.name: UMBRELLA_LEI
columns.comment: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) for an Umbrella where this is applicable.

columns.name: UMBRELLA_NAME
columns.comment: The full legal name of an Umbrella Fund as defined in the prospectus in the official language of the Umbrella Fund.

columns.name: UMBRELLA_STRUCTURE_CD
columns.comment: The organisation framework of the Fund that is legally recognised in a particular jurisdiction for conducting commercial activities of an investment vehicle.

columns.name: SYSTEM_UMBRELLA_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia assigned code specific to the Umbrella. This code is unique at Umbrella level only. (This is a primary key to link tables to Umbrella table)

columns.name: LOOKUP_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia given id for the each entry within a lookup.

columns.name: LOOKUP_KEY
columns.comment: This is the unique key of the lookup in fundi or column name in the Product ESG table

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: Service Code defining the data provider

columns.name: AS_OF_DATE
columns.comment: Business Date of Data Snapshot

columns.name: LOOKUP_VAL
columns.comment: The possible values within a lookup which is applicable to a given product.

columns.name: PROPERTY_CD
columns.comment: The unique alpha-numeric reference number associated with the building in the system of record.

columns.name: LEA_CD
columns.comment: The legal entity code that the property belongs to (i.e. the SPV/Portfolio).

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: Service Code

columns.name: VALUATION_DATE
columns.comment: The date that the valuation was performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.comment: Address.

columns.name: ANNUAL_RENT
columns.comment: Total rent payable annually under current lease terms. May differ from market rent or ERV.

columns.name: APPLIED_REVERSIONARY_YIELD
columns.comment: Yield assuming property reverts to market rent after lease expiry. Indicates future income potential.

columns.name: APPLIED_TERM_YIELD
columns.comment: Yield based on contracted income over the lease term. Reflects return assuming no reversion.

columns.name: AWULT
columns.comment: The average time (typically in years) until leases expire, giving more weight to leases that contribute more rent.

columns.name: CAP_RATE
columns.comment: The capitalisation rate represents the relationship between a property's net operating income (NOI) and its market value (or purchase price).

columns.name: CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT
columns.comment: Adjustments made to reflect capital expenditure or valuation corrections.

columns.name: CAPITAL_EXPENDITURE
columns.comment: Total capital expenditure incurred to date.

columns.name: CAPITAL_VALUE_PER_SQFT
columns.comment: The market value of a property asset, regardless of how it is financed per square foot.

columns.name: CHANGE_SINCE_LAST_VALUATION
columns.comment: The monetary amount the total capital value of the property has changed since the last time the property was valued.

columns.name: CITY
columns.comment: City.

columns.name: COMMERCIAL_FAIR_VAL
columns.comment: Market value of the commercial portion of a mixed-use asset.

columns.name: COSTS_REMAINING
columns.comment: Budgeted capital expenditure yet to be spent.

columns.name: COSTS_SPEND_TO_DATE
columns.comment: Total capital expenditure incurred to date.

columns.name: DEVELOPMENT_PROPERTY_OR_STANDING_ASSET
columns.comment: Flag to indicate whether a property is a standing asset or under development.

columns.name: EBITDAR_TO_RENT_RATIO
columns.comment: A ratio comparing a tenant's EBITDAR to the rent they pay. Used to assess the tenant's ability to cover rent obligations.

columns.name: EQUIVALENT_YIELD
columns.comment: Actual return an investor earns on a property investment, taking into account all income and costs, including the timing of cash flows.

columns.name: ERV_COVER
columns.comment: A ratio comparing the ERV to the passing rent or to the vacant possession value (VPV). Formula = ERV/VPV.

columns.name: ERV_PER_SQFT
columns.comment: Market rent per square foot that a property is expected to generate on the open market.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_RENTAL_VALUE
columns.comment: Market rent that a property is expected to generate on the open market, assuming it is leased at current market condition.

columns.name: FAIR_VAL
columns.comment: Total market value of the asset, incorporating residential and commercial components.

columns.name: GROSS_NET
columns.comment: Total gross rent on the lease.

columns.name: GROSS_VALUE
columns.comment: The total capital value of the property, typically before deductions such as purchaser's costs or liabilities.

columns.name: GROUND_RENT
columns.comment: The regular payment made by a leaseholder to the freeholder for the use of the land on which the property stands.

columns.name: INCOME_DEBT_COVER_RATIO
columns.comment: Debt Cover Ratio based on income. Measures how many times a property's income can cover its debt obligations.

columns.name: INCOME_STRUCTURE_TYPE
columns.comment: Specifies the contractual structure governing the property's income stream and ownership arrangement.

columns.name: INITIAL_YIELD
columns.comment: Measure of the return on a property investment based on the current rental income and the purchase price or market value of the property.

columns.name: IRR
columns.comment: A financial metric that estimates the profitability of an investment, taking into account all expected cash flows and the time value of money.

columns.name: LLH_UXT
columns.comment: Specified remaining lease term on a long leasehold asset.

columns.name: MCSI_SECTOR
columns.comment: The predominant use classification of the property.

columns.name: NET_INITIAL_YIELD
columns.comment: Net income divided by capital value. Key metric for immediate return on investment.

columns.name: NET_LEASABLE_AREA
columns.comment: The amount of floor space of the unit that can be leased to a tenant, in sq ft.

columns.name: NET_RENT_PER_ANNUM
columns.comment: The current total amount of annual headline rent for the lease including any prior escalations but before pass-through, percentage rent or common area charges.

columns.name: NET_REVERSIONARY_YIELD
columns.comment: Net income assuming full market rent is achieved, divided by capital value. Reflects long-term return.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_UNITS
columns.comment: Number of units within the asset.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_UNITS_RESIDENTIAL
columns.comment: Total count of residential units in the property.

columns.name: OCCUPANCY_PERCENTAGE
columns.comment: The percentage of units currently occupied versus total available.

columns.name: OWNED_PERCENTAGE
columns.comment: The percentage of ownership held in the property or unit.

columns.name: PASSING_RENT
columns.comment: The actual rent currently being paid by tenants under existing lease agreements, regardless of market conditions.

columns.name: PER_UNIT_EXCLUDING_VOIDS
columns.comment: Average income per unit, excluding vacant units.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_CHANGE_SINCE_LAST_VALUATION
columns.comment: The percentage amount the total capital value of the property has changed since the last time the property was valued.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_OF_ANNUAL_MKT_RENT
columns.comment: Ratio of actual rent received to estimated market rent. Assesses under- or over-renting.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_Z_SPREAD
columns.comment: The Z-Spread recorded at the previous valuation date.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CAPITAL_VAL
columns.comment: The entire market value of a property asset at previous valuation period, regardless of how it is financed.

columns.name: PRIVATE_RESIDENTIAL_INCOME_PER_SQFT_PASSING
columns.comment: Income from private residential leases divided by total area.

columns.name: PRIVATE_RESIDENTIAL_INCOME_PER_SQFT_REVERSIONARY
columns.comment: Income generated from private residential leases divided by the total area.

columns.name: PROPERTY_FORM_OF_TITLE
columns.comment: Flags whether the property is freehold or leasehold.

columns.name: PURCHASERS_COSTS
columns.comment: Transaction costs borne by the buyer, expressed in absolute monetary value.

columns.name: PURCHASERS_COSTS_PERCENTAGE
columns.comment: Transaction costs borne by the buyer, expressed as a percentage.

columns.name: RENT
columns.comment: The passing or estimated rental income used as the basis for the VPV calculation.

columns.name: RENT_PER_SQFT
columns.comment: The annual rent divided by the net internal area (NIA) of the unit.

columns.name: RESIDENTIAL_FAIR_VAL
columns.comment: Estimated market value of the residential portion of the asset.

columns.name: REVERSIONARY_YIELD
columns.comment: Anticipated yield a property will produce once it reaches its full market rental value (ERV).

columns.name: REVIEW_YIELD
columns.comment: The yield calculated based on the revised rent after a rent review.

columns.name: RUNNING_YIELD
columns.comment: Annual rent divided by the capital value of the property.

columns.name: SPEND_OVER_THE_QTR
columns.comment: Capital expenditure incurred during the current quarter.

columns.name: STABILISED_VAL
columns.comment: Stabilised value.

columns.name: TOTAL
columns.comment: Often refers to total valuation or income depending on context.

columns.name: TOTAL_CAPITAL_VALUE
columns.comment: The entire market value of a property asset, regardless of how it is financed.

columns.name: TOTAL_GROSS_INCOME_PASSING
columns.comment: Sum of all income streams before expenses.

columns.name: TOTAL_GROSS_INCOME_REVERSIONARY
columns.comment: Sum of all income streams before expenses.

columns.name: TOTAL_NET_INCOME_PASSING
columns.comment: Gross income minus operating expenses. Represents actual income available to the investor.

columns.name: TOTAL_NET_INCOME_REVERSIONARY
columns.comment: Gross income minus operating expenses.

columns.name: TRUE_EQUIVALENT_YIELD
columns.comment: True equivalent yield.

columns.name: VALUATION_AGENT
columns.comment: Valuation Agent.

columns.name: VALUATION_FREQ
columns.comment: Frequency that the valuation is performed.

columns.name: VALUATION_PERIOD
columns.comment: The month number the valuation was performed.

columns.name: VALUE_PER_UNIT
columns.comment: Residential fair value divided by number of units.

columns.name: VOID_PERIOD
columns.comment: Assumed rent-free or vacancy period before the property is re-let or stabilised under the VPV scenario.

columns.name: VPV
columns.comment: Represents the value of a property assuming it is unoccupied.

columns.name: VPV_ASSUMED
columns.comment: The estimated market value of the property assuming vacant possession, based on the assumptions provided by the valuation agent.

columns.name: VPV_COVER
columns.comment: VPV Cover is a derived metric that expresses the relationship between the current rent (or ERV) and the VPV.

columns.name: VPV_PER_SQFT_ASSUMED
columns.comment: The estimated market value of the property assuming vacant possession per square ft.

columns.name: YEARS_TO_REVIEW
columns.comment: The number of years remaining until the next scheduled rent review.

columns.name: YIELD
columns.comment: General term for return metrics, can refer to initial, equivalent, or reversionary yield.

columns.name: Z_SPREAD
columns.comment: The yield spread over the risk-free rate that equates the present value of cash flows to the market price of the asset.

columns.name: ACCT_CD
columns.comment: The unique account code (identifier) for all account types such as a portfolio, sleeve, index, benchmark, etc. Code defined in DIM_ACCOUNT as ACCT_CD.

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: The service code is a descriptive code corresponding to SERVICE_ID. Different services are defined per provider. Code described by SERVICE_NAME.

columns.name: AS_OF_DATE
columns.comment: Business Date of Data Snapshot

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TRADING_STATUS
columns.comment: The operational trading status of the account in the OMS. Account Trading Status identifies if an account is PENDING ACTIVE, ACTIVE, PENDING TERMINATION, CLIENT TERMINATED, OPERATIONALLY TERMINATED (cash cleared etc), CARE AND MAINTENANCE, SUSPENDED TRADING*?

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE

columns.name: COMPOSITE_FIGI
columns.comment: Twelve character, alphanumeric identifier. The first 2 characters are upper-case consonants (including "Y"), the third character is the upper-case "G", characters 4 -11 are any upper-case consonant (including "Y") or integer between 0 and 9, and the last character is a check-digit. The Composite level of assignment is provided in cases where there are multiple trading venues for the instrument within a single country or market. The Composite Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) enables users to link multiple FIGIs at the trading venue-level within the same country or market in order to obtain an aggregated view for that instrument within that country or market.  Note: Where an MTF trades multiple listings, this field will indicate the MTF as composite and the true associated market level is indicated in MTF Assc Mkt Comp Financial Instrument Global ID (ID241, MTF_ASSC_MKT_COMP_ID_BB_GLOBAL).

columns.name: CPI_REFERENCE
columns.comment: The reference CPI (Consumer Price Index) value for the underlying index of inflation-linked bonds. The reference CPI is divided by the base CPI to come up with the index ratio that is used on the inflation-adjusted calculations for a given settlement date.         For inflation-linked bonds that use the Canadian 3-month lookback model, the reference CPI changes with the current settlement date (or each day the bond trades). Reference CPI interpolates the change in CPI value two and three months from the month of the current settlement date.        For Australian and New Zealand capital index bonds, this represents the inflation adjusted value of the security in percentage form.

columns.comment: This is the code for the trading venue or environment on which the instrument  trades. If an exchange is specified, the code will be for the specified exchange. When not specified, the code will be according to the user default exchange, which can be the composite or primary exchange.

columns.name: EXCH_OTC
columns.comment: Designation if the DIM_EXCHANGE record represents the Exchange or OTC marketplace. Expected values in the table include only 'E' or 'O', NULL in cases where information is not available. Code defined in DIM_CODE_VALUE as DESC_CD where DESC_TYPE = 'EXCH_OTC'.

columns.name: EXCH_OTC_DESC
columns.comment: Description if the DIM_EXCHANGE record represents the Exchange or OTC marketplace.

columns.name: EXEC_DATETIME
columns.comment: Execution time of the fill if a single fill is attached to the placement.

columns.name: FILL_BROKER
columns.comment: Fill Broker. Code defined in DIM_BROKER as BKR_CD.

columns.name: NET_TRADE_DESC
columns.comment: Description defining if commissions are included in the price of trade. P - Principal Trade - commission are included in price of trade); A - Agency Trade - commission are not included in the price of the trade. Code defined in DIM_CODE_VALUE as DESC_CD where DESC_TYPE = 'NETTRDIND'.

columns.name: NET_TRADE_IND
columns.comment: Code defining if commissions are included in the price of trade. P - Principal Trade - commission are included in price of trade); A - Agency Trade - commission are not included in the price of the trade. Code defined in DIM_CODE_VALUE as DESC_CD where DESC_TYPE = 'NETTRDIND'.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.comment: Order Identifier from the order generating system.

columns.name: PLACE_DATE
columns.comment: The date of execution. (Exchange Time Zone)

columns.name: PLACE_DATETIME
columns.comment: The date and time of execution. (Exchange Time Zone)

columns.name: TRADING_VENUE
columns.comment: Trading Venue.  For cases where broker is used as a trading venue, codes defined in DIM_BROKER as BKR_CD, BIC, LEGAL_ENTITY_IDENTIFIER, MIC. For cases where exchange is used as a trading venue, codes defined in DIM_EXCHANGE as EXCH_CD, ISO_EXCH_CD.

columns.name: ACCT_CD
columns.comment: The account code. Code defined in DIM_ACCOUNT as ACCT_CD.

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: The service code is a descriptive code corresponding to SERVICE_ID. Different services are defined per provider. Code described by SERVICE_NAME.

columns.name: POSITION_DATE
columns.comment: The effective date of the valuation for the position.

columns.name: ACCRUED_INT_INCM
columns.comment: The value of income accumulated from accrued interest in base currency.

columns.name: ACCRUED_EXP_INCM
columns.comment: The value of income accumulated from accrued expenses in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_CRRNCY_CD
columns.comment: Base currency of the position, the primary currency used by the parent account/entity. This field is ISO compliant. Code defined in DIM_CURRENCY as CRRNCY_CD.

columns.name: BASE_MKT_VAL_DIRTY
columns.comment: The market value dirty base amount is the total asset value of the portfolio including interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment for all assets in portfolio currency.

columns.name: BASE_ORIG_COST
columns.comment: The original cost of the asset at purchase in base currency.

columns.name: FIRM_CRRNCY_CD
columns.comment: Currency used for the client level consolidated view across portfolios. This field is ISO compliant. Code defined in DIM_CURRENCY as CRRNCY_CD.

columns.name: FIRM_MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The firm market value is the total value of the portfolio for all assets in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_MKT_VAL_DIRTY
columns.comment: The market value dirty firm amount is the total asset value of the portfolio including interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment for all assets in portfolio currency.

columns.name: FIRM_ORIG_COST
columns.comment: The original cost of the assets in firm currency.

columns.name: MKT_VAL
columns.comment: Firm market value is the total value of the portfolio for all assets in base currency.

columns.name: PRVDR_NAME
columns.comment: The name describing the provider.

columns.name: TR_ID
columns.comment: The internal system ID (Fact ID) for each record in a fact table.

columns.name: POSITION_ID
columns.comment: Unique derived identifier for a position. It represents the unique combination of service identifier, position date, account, security, and long/short indicator. When no unique identifier exists from the source system, one must be generated.

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: The service code is a descriptive code corresponding to SERVICE_ID. Different services are defined per provider. Code described by SERVICE_NAME.

columns.name: POSITION_DATE
columns.comment: The effective date of the valuation for the position.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_DAYS
columns.comment: number of days used to calculate the accrued interest. This, in conjunction with the DAY_BASIS and COUPON_RATE is used to calculate interest.

columns.name: ACCT_CD
columns.comment: The account code. Code defined in DIM_ACCOUNT as ACCT_CD.

columns.name: ACT_PRC_QUOTE_TYPE_ORIG_NAME
columns.comment: Actual name of the MKT_PRC used in the valuation (supporting secondary valuation RKS).

columns.name: AMT_OUTSTANDING
columns.comment: Quantity/Amount/Shares outstanding.

columns.name: AVG_UNIT_COST
columns.comment: Average cost per unit of held position, adjusted for any acquisition costs in local currency.

columns.name: BASE_ACCRD_INT_GROSS
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period before any deduction of non-reclaimable withholding tax in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_AVG_UNIT_COST
columns.comment: The average cost per unit of the held position, adjusted for any acquisition costs in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_BOOK_VAL
columns.comment: The value of a position less its depreciated assets in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_CRRNCY_CD
columns.comment: Base currency of the position, the primary currency used by the parent account/entity. This field is ISO compliant.

columns.name: BASE_DAILY_INC_EARNED
columns.comment: The daily income earned in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_FUT_UGL
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss for futures and margined options this is the change in market value from the book cost in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_INC_AMT
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period on settled and unsettled portions of the asset in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_INC_AMT_COST
columns.comment: Accrued interest at cost in account base currency.

columns.name: BASE_INC_NET_AMT
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period after any deduction of non-reclaimable withholding tax in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_MKT_PRICE
columns.comment: The price at which an asset can be bought or sold as of the valuation date in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_MKT_VAL_DIRTY
columns.comment: The market value dirty amount includes interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment in base currency (sum of the positions owned).

columns.name: BASE_ORIG_COST
columns.comment: The original cost of the asset at purchase in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_UGL_CAP
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss is the change in market value of capital (price) from book cost that has yet to be realized on valuation date in base currency.

columns.name: BASE_UGL_TOT
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss total (BASE_UGL_CAP + BASE_UGL_CRRNCY_TOT) is the change in market value for assets based on the book cost that has yet to be realized in base currency.

columns.name: CONFIRMED_MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The market value of the position (the sum of the lots owned) using the price on the valuation date that has been confirmed by the reconciliation process in base currency.

columns.name: DIRTY_PRICE_IND
columns.comment: Code representing dirty/clean price (ex. Yes, Dirty). Used by Bonds to reflect price including accrued interest since the last accrual payment.

columns.name: EXPOSURE_AMT
columns.comment: The exposure amount is the amount of risk for the position in base currency.

columns.name: FIRM_ACCRD_INT_COST
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period on settled and unsettled portions of the asset in firm currency .

columns.name: FIRM_ACCRD_INT_GROSS
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period before any deduction of non-reclaimable withholding tax in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_ACCRD_INT_NET
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period after any deduction of non-reclaimable withholding tax in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_AVG_UNIT_COST
columns.comment: The total amortization adjusted amount for the cost of the position in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_COST
columns.comment: The original cost of the asset at purchase in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_CRRNCY_CD
columns.comment: Currency used for the client level consolidated view across portfolios. This field is ISO compliant. Code defined in DIM_CURRENCY as CRRNCY_CD.

columns.name: FIRM_MKT_PRICE
columns.comment: The price at which an asset can be bought or sold as of the valuation date in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The market value clean amount excludes interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment in firm currency (sum of the positions owned).

columns.name: FIRM_UGL_CAP
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss is the change in market value of capital (price) from book cost that has yet to be realized in firm currency.

columns.name: FIRM_UGL_TOT
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss total (FIRM_UGL_CAP + FIRM_UGL_CRRNCY_TOT) is the change in market value for assets based on the book cost that has yet to be realized in firm currency.

columns.name: FX_RATE_BASE_TO_LOC
columns.comment: The exchange rate from local to the base currency.

columns.name: FX_RATE_FIRM_TO_LOC
columns.comment: The exchange rate from local to the firm currency.

columns.name: INC_AMT
columns.comment: The value of accrued income on this position in the current coupon period (settled + unsettled portions) as of valuation date in local currency.

columns.name: INC_AMT_COST
columns.comment: Local accrued interest at cost in local currency.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_DATETIME
columns.comment: The system field to mark the last time a record was inserted or updated.

columns.name: LOC_ACCRD_INT_GROSS
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period before any deduction of non-reclaimable withholding tax in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_ACCRD_INT_NET
columns.comment: The value of interest accumulated in coupon period after any deduction of non-reclaimable withholding tax in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_BOOK_VAL
columns.comment: The value of a position less its depreciated assets in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_CRRNCY_CD
columns.comment: The pricing/settlement currency of the asset. Code defined in DIM_CURRENCY as CRRNCY_CD.

columns.name: LOC_DAILY_INC_EARNED
columns.comment: The daily income earned in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_EXPOSURE_AMT
columns.comment: The amount at risk for positions in the local currency.

columns.name: LOC_FUT_UGL
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss for futures and margined options this is the change in market value from the book cost in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The market value clean amount excludes interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment in local currency (sum of the positions owned).

columns.name: LOC_MKT_VAL_DIRTY
columns.comment: The market value dirty amount includes interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment in local currency (sum of the positions owned).

columns.name: LOC_UGL_CAP
columns.comment: The unrealized gain loss is the change in market value of capital (price) from book cost that has yet to be realized in local currency.

columns.name: LOC_UGL_TOT
columns.comment: The unrealized (on holdings) gains/loss amount. This is what would be realized if a holding was sold as determined by the mark- to-market of the position stated in the local currency.

columns.name: LONG_SHT_CD
columns.comment: The long/short code. Valid values: L - Long, S - Short.

columns.name: MKT_PRICE
columns.comment: The price at which an asset can be bought or sold as of the valuation date in local currency.

columns.name: MKT_PRICE_DATETIME
columns.comment: The date and time for which the pricing information is valid.

columns.name: MKT_VAL
columns.comment: The market value clean amount is the valuation of the security using the price on the valuation date. This value excludes interest accrued since the issue of the most recent coupon payment in base currency (sum of the positions owned).

columns.name: MODEL_PERCENT
columns.comment: The percentage the given model account contains of the given security.

columns.name: ORIG_COST
columns.comment: The original cost of the asset at purchase in local currency.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_FACE
columns.comment: The total balance of the mortgage on issue date. This is used with the factor to calculate current face.

columns.name: PRICING_MULTIPLIER
columns.comment: The contract multiplier determines the dollar value of each point of price movement.

columns.name: PRVDR_NAME
columns.comment: The name associated with the PRVDR_ID describing the provider.

columns.name: QTY
columns.comment: The quantity, number of shares, units, par, or contracts. Registered units held.

columns.name: SEC_ID
columns.comment: Identifier of the security. Identifier defined in DIM_SECURITY as SEC_ID.

columns.name: STATUS_CD
columns.comment: Valid values are ACTIVE / INACTIVE

columns.name: TR_ID
columns.comment: The internal system ID (Fact ID) for each record in a fact table.

columns.name: VENDOR_CD
columns.comment: Internal code assigned to the price data source or vendor

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.comment: Name of the price data source or vendor name

columns.name: SYSTEM_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: Fundipedia assigned code specific to the Product. This code is unique at Product level only. (This is a primary key to link tables to Product)

columns.name: SERVICE_CD
columns.comment: Service Code defining the data provider

columns.name: AS_OF_DATE
columns.comment: Business Date of Data Snapshot

columns.name: ABI_SECTOR
columns.comment: ABI sectors are defined by the Association of British Insurers (ABI). They are a way of grouping funds with similar characteristics so they’re easier to compare.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_EXPENSES
columns.comment: An allowance for variable fund expenses not included in the Investment Management Charge (IMC). This charge includes the OCF and operation expenses produced annually

columns.name: ADVANCED_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Is this share class suitable to be marketed to an end investor, who can be classified as an 'experienced investor'?
An experienced investor typically has at least one of the following characteristics:
-- good knowledge of relevant financial products and transactions
-- financial industry experience or is accompanied by professional investment advice
Therefore, an informed investor can make an informed investment decision based only on the regulated and authorised offering documentation, together with knowledge and understanding of the specific factors/risks highlighted within them.

columns.name: APPROVED_FOR_DB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved for use by Defined Benefit Pension Schemes (DB).  This is typically "Yes", unless the fund has specific Defined Contribution (DC) features and/or the fund is net of charges or is only available on a daily basis (midday in particular).

columns.name: APPROVED_FOR_DC_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved for use by Defined Contribution Pension Schemes (DC).  The fund would need to have been assessed for any features which would make the fund less appropriate to be applied to DC members. Typically this would not be a "Yes" if the fund is only made available on a weekly basis.

columns.name: ASSESSMENT_OF_VALUE_REQUIRED_UNDER_COLL_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates whether  Assessment Of Value is required Under FCA COLL (Collective Investment Schemes Sourcebook) rules. The FCA require authorised fund managers (AFMs) to assess the value for money of each fund.

columns.name: ASSET_CLASS
columns.comment: A grouping of securities, as per the LGIM taxonomy, that exhibit similar characteristics and behave similarly in the marketplace.

columns.name: ASSET_CLASS_SUB_CATEGORY_UBS_VAL
columns.comment: A sub-segment of the Fixed Income Asset Class to provide more granular detail. The Asset Class Sub-Category is a group of securities that exhibit similar characteristics with each other, and also with the broader Asset Class it is part of.

columns.name: AUM_BASED_ON
columns.comment: The Fund(s) from which the AUM (Assets Under Management) should be determined, likely to be the Parent Fund

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_EUR_OLAB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved to be accessed by Non UK Pension Schemes (e.g. Ireland), known as "OLAB" (Overseas Life Assurance Business) which subscribe to the funds in EUR.  Certain funds will be restricted so that OLAB funds cannot access them due to difference in tax treatment on the underlying assets.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_GBP_OLAB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved to be accessed by Non UK Pension Schemes (e.g. Channel Islands, Isle of Man), known as "OLAB" (Overseas Life Assurance Business) which subscribe to the funds in GBP.  Certain funds will be restricted so that OLAB funds cannot access them due to difference in tax treatment on the underlying assets.

columns.name: AVAILABLE_TO_UK_NON_OLAB_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund has been approved to be accessed by UK Pension Schemes (excluding Channel Islands, Isle of Man).  Generally a "Yes" except specific funds which may be restricted for tax purposes (as there is usually a preferential version available). Certain funds are restricted to UK Pension Schemes which are marked as "PMC Only" for tax purposes.

columns.name: BASIC_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Is this share class suitable to be marketed to an end investor, who has only basic knowledge about financial product, but access to imperative legal documentation and basic information provided by the point of sale?
An investor with basic knowledge is defined as an investor, who has
-- no financial industry experience or
-- is investing for the first time in this kind of financial product.

columns.name: BESPOKE_OR_POOLED_PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.comment: Internal identifier for PMC client type (Bespoke - Single /Pooled - Multi investor)

columns.name: BIC_OF_TRANSFER_AGENT
columns.comment: BIC (bank identifier code) for the transfer agent entity of the fund. ISO 9362 defines a standard format of Bank Identifier Codes (also known as SWIFT-BIC, BIC, SWIFT ID or SWIFT code) approved by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

columns.name: BOARD_GENERAL_PARTNER
columns.comment: The entity or individuals responsible for managing the fund, typically the General Partner (GP) in a limited partnership structure.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_100M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets under [$]100M, in basis points.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_100M_250M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets between [$]100M and [$]250M, in basis points.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_250M_500M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets between [$]250M and [$]500M, in basis points.

columns.name: BPS_FEE_500M
columns.comment: Flat fee assessed on all assets for accounts with assets over [$]500M, in basis points.

columns.name: BUSINESS_CAPABILITY
columns.comment: Investment capabilities the firm offers

columns.name: CAN_OVERRIDE_WEEKLY_TO_MONTHLY_IND
columns.comment: A marker for Huguenot to change the wording relating from the default of "weekly" to "monthly" for the funds which are only available on a monthly basis

columns.name: CBI_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.comment: Central bank of Ireland approval date of supplement

columns.name: CBI_CD
columns.comment: Identification code of the approved share class as issued by the regulatory body i.e. CBI

columns.name: CCI_ADVERSE_MARKET_REDEMPTION
columns.comment: A brief explanation of what outcome the investor may expect where the CCI matures, is redeemed, sold, or encashed under severely adverse market conditions

columns.name: CCI_APPROPRIATE_MAIN_PERFORMANCE_DRIVERS
columns.comment: Appropriate performance information summary in narrative form covering the main drivers of investment performance for the CCI

columns.name: CCI_ESG_OBJECTIVES_INFORMATION
columns.comment: Description of any environmental or social objectives of the consumer composite investment

columns.name: CCI_INVESTMENT_DESC
columns.comment: Medium form narrative text version of the investment policy/fund description, which, when combined with the investment objective field (for regulated funds only), is included in the CCI. This is drafted specifically to meet the requirements of this regulatory document.

columns.name: CCI_REQUIRED_IND
columns.comment: CCI required indicator (Flag for Consumer Composite Investment)

columns.name: CCI_RETURN_CONDITIONS_HIGHER_EXPLANATION
columns.comment: A brief explanation of the kind of conditions whereby the CCI is likely to generate higher returns, or lead to investment  gains

columns.name: CCI_RETURN_CONDITIONS_LOWER_EXPLANATION
columns.comment: A brief explanation of the kinds of conditions whereby the consumer composite investment is likely to generate lower returns, or lead to investment loss

columns.name: CCI_UNDERLYING_INVESTMENT_ASSETS
columns.comment: Describes any underlying investment assets or reference values and an explanation of how they relate to the value of the consumer composite investment;

columns.name: CITI_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: CITI generated identifier at Product level.

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_CAN_BEAR_LIMITED_CAPITAL_LOSS_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who is seeking capital preservation or who can bear only limited capital losses that are specified in product's documentation.

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_CAN_BEAR_LOSS_BEYOND_CAPITAL_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who can bear losses even higher than the total amount of his invested capital?

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_CANNOT_BEAR_CAPITAL_LOSS_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who cannot bear any capital losses?

columns.name: CLIENTS_WHO_DO_NOT_NEED_CAPITAL_GUARANTEE_VAL
columns.comment: May a distributor sell this fund to an end investor, who can bear a loss of the total amount of his invested capital?

columns.name: CLOSE_DATE
columns.comment: Date in which client/fund closes

columns.name: COMMITMENT_LEVERAGE_RATIO
columns.comment: The Commitment Method for calculating leverage involves summing the absolute values of an Alternative Investment Fund's (AIF) positions, including the reinvestment of borrowings, and then offsetting certain hedging and netting arrangements to arrive at the total exposure. This calculated exposure is then divided by the AIF's net asset value (NAV) to determine its leverage ratio.

columns.name: COMPREHENSION_CLASSIFICATION
columns.comment:
MIFID securities classification. According to Art. 25 (4)(a) of the MiFID II Directive 2014/65/EU from 15/05/14 or according to PRIIPs RTS Article 8(3)(b) of PRIIPs regulation (EU) No 1286/2014 :
1) Non-complex products are:
     - Shares admitted to trading on a regulated market 
     - Bonds or other forms of securitised debt admitted to trading on a regulated market 
     - Money-market instruments
     - Shares or units in UCITS
     - Structured deposits
2) Complex products are:
    - Shares in non-UCITS collective investment undertakings and shares that embed a derivative
    - Bonds that embed a derivative or incorporate a structure which makes it difficult for the client to understand the risk involved
    - Money-market instruments that embed a derivative or incorporate a structure which makes it difficult for the client to understand the risk    involved
     - Structured UCITS as referred to in the second subparagraph of Article 36(1) of Regulation (EU) No 583/2010;
     - Structured deposits that incorporate a structure which makes it difficult for the client to understand the risk of return or the cost of exiting the product before term."

columns.name: CONSIDERS_CLIENT_SUSTAINABILITY_PREFERENCES_VAL
columns.comment: Is the fund compatible with investor preference for investments with an environmental, social and governance (ESG) focus?

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_IND
columns.comment: Shows which products meet the definition of 'Consolidated' for L&G Group Financial Reporting. Once L&G's ownership of an L&G product reaches 30%, it becomes potentially in scope for IFRS reporting, dependant on final decision from Group.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_IND_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.comment: The date on which a change to the consolidated indicator has been applied

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_BENCHMARK_APPLICABLE
columns.comment: Indicates if a benchmark is 'in' or 'out' of scope of the benchmark regulation.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_BENCHMARK_NAME
columns.comment: Where a fund falls in scope of the Benchmark Regulation, a Contingency Benchmark will be required to be identified and stored for reference.

columns.name: COSTS_INCLUDE_DISTRIBUTION_FEE_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of conditional regulatory text for PRIIPs KIDs supplied in Annex VII. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"These figures include the maximum distribution fee that the person selling you the product may charge ([] % of amount invested/[] EUR). This person will inform you of the actual distribution fee."

columns.name: COSTS_SHARED_WITH_SELLER_VAL
CREDIT_RISK_IND
CREDIT_RISK_MEASURE_VAL
CUSIP
columns.comment: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures' and refers to a 9-digit alphanumeric code assigned to all security issues approved for trading in the United States and Canada.

columns.name: DC_FUND_TYPE
columns.comment: This is an indicator used to determine whether a DC fund invests into one underlying PMC (Single) or multiple underlying PMCs (Blended).

columns.name: DEALING_CUT_OFF_TIME
columns.comment: Dealing cut off time for a Product

columns.name: DEALING_FREQ
columns.comment: Frequency at which fund is traded

columns.name: DEFERRAL_PERIOD_IN_MONTHS
columns.comment: If a Fund is able to defer redemptions this attribute will outline the number of months it can be deferred.

columns.name: DEFERRALS_ALLOWED_IND
columns.comment: Some Funds reserve the right to defer redemption requests, e.g. redemptions can be dererred for a period of time. This attribute will outline whether this is possible.

columns.name: DESC_OF_FUND_FULL_NAME
columns.comment: Full Fund Name of the Product as recorded in Fund Literature

columns.name: DILUTION_METHOD_VAL
columns.comment: The dilution method is the mechanism used to protect existing investors from bearing the costs of buying or selling the underlying investments as a result of large inflows into or outflows from a fund. This could be a "Dilution Levy" charged to the investor or "Dilution Adjustment" where the price is swung to adjust for the associated cost of leaving the fund

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_FREQ
columns.comment: The frequency at which Funds distribute dividends.

columns.name: DYNAMIC_PLANNER_TARGETED_VAL
columns.comment: Confirms the fund aligns with a specific risk profile (risk level 1–10) in the Dynamic Planner system.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_COUNTERPARTY_VAL
ELIGIBLE_FOR_ADVISED_RETAIL_DISTRIBUTION_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients by a distributor who advices the end investor? - As this is also dependent from investors ability to bear losses and time horizon, this field can only give an indication to the distributer about how the manufacturer sees it.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_EXECUTION_ONLY_DISTRIBUTION_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients through an execution only channel, e.g. internet platforms, if the end investor is provided the necessary legal documentation? - As this is also dependent from investors knowledge and experience, this field can only give an indication to the distribution channel about how the manufacturer sees it.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_EXECUTION_ONLY_WITH_APPROPRIATENESS_TEST_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients through an execution only channel, e.g. internet platforms, if the end investor is provided the necessary legal documentation and also checks, whether the client has sufficient knowledge, i.e. by providing online tests or by checking client's existing investments? - As this is also dependent from investors knowledge and experience, this field can only give an indication to the distribution channel about how the manufacturer sees it.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_FOR_PORTFOLIO_MANAGEMENT_VAL
columns.comment: From a manufacturer' view: Can this fund be sold to clients who have given a discretionary mandate to a professional portfolio manager? - As the portfolio manager has the obligation to balance out the portfolio with his client's needs, the usual answer to this field should be "yes".

columns.name: EMBEDDED_DERIVATIVES_IND
columns.comment: If the prospectus allows the usage of derivatives for Efficient Portfolio Management, it will not be classified as a derivative product, i.e. it has no embedded derivatives. 'Yes' means that the fund might be classified as a derivative product and therefore might be classified as riskier.

columns.name: EMT_EPT_TYPE_OF_IDENTIFICATION_CODE_VAL
columns.comment:
Codification chosen to identify the financial instrument. 

One of the options in the following closed list to be used:
1 - ISO 6166 for ISIN code
2 - CUSIP (The Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures number assigned by the CUSIP Service Bureau for U.S. and Canadian companies)
3 - SEDOL (Stock Exchange Daily Official List for the London Stock Exchange)
4 – WKN (Wertpapier Kenn-Nummer, the alphanumeric German identification number)
5 - Bloomberg Ticker (Bloomberg letters code that identify a company's securities)
6 - BBGID (The Bloomberg Global ID)
7 - Reuters RIC (Reuters instrument code)
8 – FIGI (Financial Instrument Global Identifier)
9 - Other code by members of the Association of National Numbering Agencies
10 - LEI
99 - Code attributed by the undertaking

columns.name: EVENT_CUTTOFF_TIME_ZONE
columns.comment:
Relevant time zone for "OFST410100 Cut-off Time For Subscription" or "OFST430100 Cut-off Time For Redemption" in local standard time format._x000D_
_x000D_
Helpful links can be found at:_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_time_zones_by_country_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time_x000D_
- https://www.timeanddate.com/time/zones_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daylight_saving_time_x000D_
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tz_database_x000D_
_x000D_
Commonly used standard time formats are:_x000D_
- EST    Eastern Time Zone (USA); UTC-05:00_x000D_
- CST   Central Time Zone (USA); UTC-06:00_x000D_
- PST    Pacific Time Zone (USA); UTC-07:00_x000D_
- CET   Central European Time; UTC+01:00_x000D_
- HKT   Hong Kong Time; UTC+08:00_x000D_
- SST    Singapore Standard Time; UTC+08:00_x000D_
_x000D_
Please note, that mentioning the abbreviation of a standard time zone is an approximation as there are many countries that know daylight saving time. In this case openfunds would assume only mentioning one abbreviation, e.g. CET for Central European Time, despite between March and October it should be CEST for Central European Summer Time._x000D_
_x000D_
Additionally, openfunds recommends not to use this field for automatic implementation, as there are quite some identical abbreviations for different time zones, e.g. ADT stands for Arabia Daylight Time (UTC+3:00) or Atlantic Daylight Time (UTC-3:00)._x000D_
_x000D_
For automatic information exchange please refer to "OFST410092 Time Zone For Cut-off Using TZ Database"

columns.name: FEE_TIER_1_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the first portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 1 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 1 MV, this is a flat fee assessed across all asset levels.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_2_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 2 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 2 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing Tier 1 MV.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_3_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 3 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 3 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_4_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 4 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 4 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_5_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 5 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 5 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_6_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 6 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 6 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TIER_7_BPS
columns.comment: Fee assessed on the second portion of an account's assets, based on Tier 7 MV in basis points. If there is no value in Tier 7 MV, this fee is assessed across all asset levels surpassing the sum of the previous MV tiers.

columns.name: FEE_TYPE

columns.name: FEEDER_IND

columns.comment: Closed ended funds will have a specified period in which they can raise capital. This attribute will be the end date of the first close.

columns.name: FIRST_CLOSE_START_DATE

columns.name: FLAT_AMC
columns.comment: The ad valorem fee is based on the average value of the policy’s holdings - on a dealing price basis in the daily dealt funds.

columns.name: FPF_CD

columns.name: FUND_BATCH_TYPE
columns.comment: Used for grouping individual funds of a similar nature e.g. single stock gilt funds (batched funds) or funds which are similar, but have different 'maturities' e.g. target date funds (cohorts)

columns.comment: The Fund Calendar assigned to this product based on fund type and geographic considerations.

columns.name: FUND_GROUP_VAL
columns.comment: Indicates the asset types within the Fund's investment profile

columns.name: FUND_LENDING_CD
columns.comment: Only required for LLC pooled funds, indicates if Fund is lending or non lending

columns.comment: This is the Fund Name which is displayed on factsheets for DC (Workplace and Non-Workplace) funds.

columns.name: FUND_OF_FUNDS_IND
columns.comment: The Fund invests into other pooled funds vs. exclusively investing in direct securities.

columns.name: FUND_PERFORMANCE_DATE
columns.comment: The date that performance history is available from if no override

columns.name: FUND_STATUS_DESC
columns.comment: Indicates if the Fund is or will be captured in the Description of Funds

columns.name: GATING_ALLOWED_IND
columns.comment: Some Funds reserve the right to gate, e.g. not allow further redemptions. This attribute will outline whether this is possible.

columns.name: GEARING_RATIO
columns.comment: The metric that shows how much debt a company uses to finance its assets compared to the equity provided by shareholders

columns.name: GENERAL_CLASSIFICATION_VAL
columns.comment: Internal classification to indicate if the PMC Fund is Standard (available to multiple investors), Client Specific (available to a single investor or closely related investors), Externally Managed (invests in a collective investment scheme not managed within the L&G Group), Transition (a short term restructuring account) or other (typically operational or obsolete)

columns.name: GERMAN_INVESTMENT_TAX_IND
columns.comment:
Is the fund an investment fund according to §1 of the German Investment Tax Act (Investmentsteuergesetz, InvStG)? If the fund is not subject to the German Investment Tax Act, the answer is no. _x000D_
_x000D_
The relevant paragraphs can be found at (only in German):_x000D_
http://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/invstg_2018/BJNR173010016.html#BJNR173010016BJNG000100000

columns.name: GERMAN_TAX_CATEGORY
columns.comment: German tax category as regulated by the German Investmentsteuergesetz (InvStG) §5ff. This field is used to indicate whether the German authorities regard investors as owners of units in the fund (intransparent) or as owners of a share of the underlying fund assets ('transparent')”

columns.name: GROSS_LEVERAGE_RATIO
columns.comment: Under AIFMD (Alternative Investment Fund Managers Directive), gross leverage measures a fund's total exposure by summing the absolute values of all positions, excluding highly liquid cash and cash equivalents but including reinvested cash borrowings and the equivalent exposure from derivatives. This figure is then compared to the fund's Net Asset Value (NAV) to determine the gross leverage ratio, indicating the total exposure regardless of any hedging or netting strategies.

columns.name: GROSS_OR_NET_RETURNS
columns.comment: Whether the return type is gross or net. This would typically be where fees are applicable.

columns.name: HAS_CAPITA_PRESERVATION_VAL
columns.comment:
Identifies if a capital preservation method is used (yes) or not (no).

This field should be used if the loss of a fund over a certain time period (e.g. monthly or annually) is limited due to a (partial) guarantee (e.g. 75% or 90%). It might be different from the field OFEP040810 EPT Capital Guarantee Level which specifies the level of guarantee at the RHP. 

//This field was declared mandatory for the German market (PIA model) by the European Working Group in their PRIIPs Data Dictionary Template (EPT). The correspondent PRIIP field within the PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT) is:
EPT: 06040_Existing_Capital_Preservation//

columns.name: HAS_CAPITAL_GUARANTEE_AGAINST_CREDIT_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element I in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"If we are not able to pay you what is owed, you could lose your entire investment."

columns.name: HAS_CAPITAL_GUARANTEE_IND
columns.comment:
Has the fund a general capital guarantee? If the answer is "no", "OFEP040840 EPT Capital Guarantee Characteristics", "OFEP040810 EPT Capital Guarantee Level", "OFEP040820 EPT Capital Guarantee Limitations" and "OFEP040830 EPT Capital Guarantee Early Exit Conditions Date" should be kept empty.

//This field was introduced by the European Working Group with their EPT PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT).
EPT: 04080_Capital_Guarantee//

Also used as a boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element F in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"[You are entitled to receive back at least [insert %] of your capital. Any amount over this, and any additional return, depends on future market performance and is uncertain.]"

columns.name: HAS_CAPITAL_PROTECTION_AGAINST_MARKET_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element H in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"[This product does not include any protection from future market performance so you could lose some or all of your investment.]"

columns.name: HAS_CONSUMER_PROTECTION_SCHEME_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element J in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"[However, you may benefit from a consumer protection scheme (see the section ‘what happens if we are unable to pay you’). The indicator shown above does not consider this protection.]"

columns.name: HAS_CPPI_VAL
HAS_CURRENCY_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
PRIIPs Risk Narrative - Element C

A boolean indicator of whether or not a share class is subject to currency risk:

Annex III Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/653, as amended by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1666 states:

// 7. For the purposes of the SRI presentation [...] the following narrative explanations shall be used, as appropriate:

[[Where applicable]: Element C, in bold] Be aware of currency risk. You will receive payments in a different currency, so the final return you will get depend on the exchange rate between the two currencies. This risk is not considered in the indicator shown above.

columns.name: HAS_DAILY_MIDDAY_IND

columns.name: HAS_FACILITIES_AGENT_IND
columns.comment: Yes/No response – does a “Facilities Agent” provide facilities for the fund/product

columns.name: HAS_FURTHER_PAYMENT_RISK_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex III, Element D in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"In some circumstances you may be required to make further payments for losses. The total loss you may incur may significantly exceed the amount invested".

columns.name: HAS_INCIDENTAL_COSTS_IND
HAS_MINIMUM_GUARANTEED_RETURNS_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of conditional regulatory text for PRIIPs KIDs supplied in Annex III. The regulatory wording is outlined below.

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"There is no minimum guaranteed return. You could lose some or all of your investment".

columns.name: HAS_PERFORMANCE_FEE_VAL
columns.comment: Does the prospectus facilitate a performance fee? If there exists a Performance fee, please fill this field with "yes" and provide respective data in the field "OFST451028 Performance Fee Applied". Otherwise, fill this field with "no" and leave the field "OFST451028 Performance Fee Applied" empty.

columns.name: HAS_RESTRICTIONS_TO_CASH_IN_EARLY_IND
columns.comment:
A boolean indicator for the inclusion of Annex V, Element F in PRIIPs KIDs. The regulatory wording is outlined below:

Regulatory references are in relation to CDR (EU) 2017/653, as amended 01/01/2023.

"This product cannot be [easily] cashed in. If you exit the investment earlier than the recommended holding period [you do not have a guarantee](where there is a guarantee only at the recommended holding period) [and] [you [will/may] have to pay extra costs] (where there are exit costs)."

columns.name: HAS_RISK_LIMIT_IND
columns.comment: Please choose 'yes', if the fund has a risk limit. This is quite common for minimum variance portfolios.  Only required where 'Is Flexible' is set to 'Yes'.

columns.name: INFORMED_INVESTOR_VAL
columns.comment:
Is this share class suitable to be marketed to an end investor, who can be classified as an 'informed investor'?
An informed investor typically has at least one of the following characteristics:
-- average knowledge of relevant financial products
-- some financial industry experience
Therefore, an informed investor can make an informed investment decision based only on the regulated and authorised offering documentation, together with knowledge and understanding of the specific factors/risks highlighted within them.

columns.name: LEI
columns.comment: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) for a fund, where this is applicable, i.e. for a FCP. The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) code is designed to create a global reference data system that uniquely identifies every legal entity or structure, in any jurisdiction, that is part of a financial transaction. The 2 digit alpha numeric code is constructed as follows: Local Operating Unit (4 characters) - Reserved characters (2) - Entity Identifier (12) - Verification ID (2).

columns.name: LEVERAGED_IND
columns.comment: Is the fund allowed to leverage the fund's asset in order to achieve accelerated returns?

columns.name: LGIM_COMPANY_ID
columns.comment: System generated Unique Fundipedia Company ID for LGIM purposes.

columns.name: LGIM_EUROPE_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.comment: LGIM Europe approval date of supplement

columns.name: LGIM_PRODUCT_ID
columns.comment: Unique Fundipedia ID for LGIM.

columns.name: LIMITED_CAPITAL_LOSS_LEVEL_VAL
columns.comment: The level of potential losses can be calculated according to the offering documentation. This field is only to be used, if a partial capital guarantee is provided on the primary market and the product is held until the maturity.

columns.name: LIMITED_PARTNERSHIP_AGREEMENT
columns.comment: Hyperlink to the LPA - The foundational legal document for a limited partnership fund, detailing roles, responsibilities, fees, and governance.

columns.name: LIQUIDITY_PARAMETERS
columns.comment: Some Funds will have set liquidity parameters, e.g. how much liquidity the Fund has to hold such as 10% of NAV.

columns.name: LIQUIDITY_RISK_INDICATOR_VAL
columns.comment: PMC Field - An indicator required for PRIIPS kids in relation to the liquidity profile of the fund

columns.name: LIRMS_APPROVAL_DATE
columns.comment: LIRMS Board approval date of supplement

columns.name: LIRMS_SUPPLEMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE

columns.name: LOWER_RANGE_OF_RETURN_TARGET
columns.comment: Lower range of return e.g. if 7%-9% then 7%

columns.name: LTV_LEVERAGE_RATIO
columns.comment: (Loan Amount / Asset Value) * 100

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_FEE_TYPE_ID
columns.comment: The structure of the management fee component of the product or share classes’ pricing structure (i.e. tiered, fixed account size, flat)

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_FEE_TYPE_VAL
columns.comment: The structure of the management fee component of the product or share classes’ pricing structure (i.e. tiered, fixed account size, flat)

columns.name: MANAGEMENT_STYLE
columns.comment: Management style as active or passive

columns.name: MANUFACTURER_PRODUCT_GOVERNANCE_PROCESS_VAL
columns.comment:
An indication of how closely the manufacturer's product governance procedure follows MiFID II.

A = Product governance procedure pursuant to MiFID II 
B = Product governance procedure comparable to MiFID II 
C = Product governance procedure not in accordance with MiFID II 
D = No information is requested from the issuer

EMT: 00075_Financial_Instrument_Issuer_Product_Governance_Process. This is an Optional EMT field.//

columns.name: MARKET_MAKER_NAME
columns.comment: Company names performing market making at this stock exchange. Multiple market maker names are separated by pipe '|'' (ASCII 124) as company names may contain commas. Please note that this field is only meaningful for ETFs. Therefore, leave empty for non ETFs. This field's OF-ID can also include a language tag, i.e. OFST002000(zh-Hant) for Market Maker Name written in traditional Chinese. For more information please refer to https://www.openfunds.org/en/language-tags.

columns.name: MATURITY_DATE_INDICATOR_IND
columns.comment:
Indicates the existence of a contractual maturity date of the portfolio.

//The correspondent PRIIP field introduced by the European Working Group with their PRIIPS Data Dictionary Template (EPT) is: EPT: 01125_Has_A_Contractual_Maturity_Date//

columns.name: MAX_DECIMALS_PRICE
columns.comment: Max length of decimal for price

columns.name: MAX_LEVERAGE_LIMIT

columns.name: MAX_LEVERAGE_LIMIT_GROSS
